jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) Local is a hard services-led, tailored facility management solution. We self-perform hard services while partnering with best-in-class soft service providers to offer custom facility and project management solutions to our clients. We focus on empowering our team with a high-level of downstream accountability, resulting in an agile and efficient service delivery.

In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best-in-Class services, including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience.

**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Project Coordinator, you will provide support to project management operations, administration, and management for projects from start through completion.

  

This job is part of the Project Management function.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* Ensure business policies and processes are effectively communicated and implemented within the Projects team.
* Ensure the provision of Health and Safe working conditions and that both clients and company health and safety policy and process is effectively implemented across the Business Unit.
* Effectively manage project teams financial commitments, raising POs, billing and managing financial.
* Develop project review pack.
* Management of all QHSE online reporting (to include Hazards, SmoWP, Audits).
* Completion of Audit Schedule.
* Ensure staffing structures on all contracts are updated when requested.
* Ad hoc event management upon request.
* Working with other Operational managers to ensure the collaborative development of the business, effective team working, and support to colleagues.
* Promoting and maintaining the core Values of CBRE Managed Services.
* Provision of guidance, advice, coaching and support to all other Project Coordinators within the business, where required to deliver best practice selection, training, assessment and recognition/reward.

* Provide a learning environment, and appropriate training and development planning. Ensure basic training needs are delivered, employees are fully competent to undertake their roles, and are able to reach their full future potential whilst updating and managing training matrix.

* Ensure the completion of all Pre-Qualifying Questionnaires for the Business Unit.

* Support of Mobilization as and when require.

* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required. Minimum of 1-2 two years of related experience and/or training.
* Experience in administration or similar projects coordinator role
* Delivery of wider facilities management services is desirable
* Interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong influencing skills and the ability to inspire confidence
* Can manage a high degree of variability
* Results focused
* Excellent motivational and influencing skills, with high levels of personal integrity
* Organized, able to prioritize and deliver within high pressure, business critical environments
* Basic analytical skills and financial terms and principles.
* Capability of understanding and following general instructions and ability to solve problems.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word and Outlook.
* Decision making ability with a general understanding of procedures and company policies to achieve goals and deadlines.

We lead by example, guided by the needs of the cities we inhabit, the communities we build, and the world we live in. The more perspectives we have, the more dimensions we’re able to see. A culture of respect, integrity, service, and excellence shapes our approach to every opportunity.

Job Description:

**Case Manager**

**Essex Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting on the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their careers.

**Program Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s The Essex Supportive Services Program provides on-site clinical case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include clinical case management and behavioral health counseling, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. Felton is committed to implementing evidence-based practices and behavioral health research within its community-based mental health services.

**Job Description**

The Case Manager provides direct service for individuals experiencing homelessness, substance use, mental health needs, and medical complexity. Under the supervision of the Lead Clinical Case Manager, the Case Manager participates in a multidisciplinary team, including external and internal agency team members consisting of mental health clinicians, primary care providers, nurses, peer specialists, interns, and psychiatric medication providers. The program serves 84 tenants at the Essex Hotel. The Case Manager holds a full caseload, evaluates the needs, and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the tenants. The Case Manager provides specialized mental health services, rehabilitative skills training, crisis intervention, and case management services. Services may include connection to community resources, client advocacy, and engagement strategies. The Case Manager maintains accurate, detailed records of client contacts and incident reports as required by Felton, HSH, ONE system, and county and state regulations.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Participate closely with an interdisciplinary team and collaborate with property management.
* Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.
* Participate in intakes and service plan development for adults with a history of being unhoused and other psychiatric or medical conditions or disabilities.
* Recommend case management services, which could include connection to primary care, coordination with other providers and community resources, housing stabilization services, etc.
* Maintain records of each client contact or service in accordance with mandated standards of HSH and Felton. Meet requirements of timely access for client care and documentation.
* Participate in team meetings and case conferences through presentation of cases, discussion of issues, and exchange of information and ideas.
* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Develop systems and maintain ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices for the teams.
* Accountable for data input into the ONE and CIRCE systems to maintain client records related to housing per HSH standards.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.
* Provide activities and groups with the tenants.
* Advise tenants to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Recommend specific housing needs via training, coaching, or community resource referrals to support tenants in maintaining stable housing.
* Participate in emergency wellness checks
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or related fields of study required.
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in case management and mental health services with severely mentally ill, dually diagnosed, formerly unhoused adults.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multidisciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, documentation, time management, and interpersonal skills.
* Problem-solving skills: able to discern when to consult, when to make independent decisions, and able to offer suggestions for solutions.
* Experience managing crisis situations, skilled at crisis response, crisis de-escalation, and risk mitigation.

jobs.description:

---------------

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.

**About the Role**
------------------

Research Program Managers at Reflection are high-leverage leaders and operators who embed directly with research and infrastructure teams to accelerate the pace of frontier model development. They are not project trackers. They are force multipliers who bring clarity to ambiguity, drive decisions when the path forward is unclear, and ensure that the work happening across multiple teams connects into a coherent whole.

This role focuses on scaling our research infrastructure to continue to support massive, frontier-scale training runs across pre-training, mid-training, and post-training.

As a central mandate, you will help drive the scaling and continued evolution of our training stack. You will help gather and unify requirements, scope, and drive this scale-up rewrite of the trainer with the Research and GPU Infra engineers who build and operate our training frameworks. This role involves weaving requirements across all stages of our training pipeline: pre-training, mid-training workloads that pair the trainer with a high-throughput inference engine for RL, post-training, etc. We are looking for someone who has gone deep with GPU infrastructure teams to build training frameworks and has accumulated the scar tissue to prove it – you know firsthand which abstractions hold at 10K+ GPU scale and which ones don’t, and you can bring that judgment to a multi-quarter program of a training stack rewrite.

You bring a first-responder mentality. When things go sideways, you don't wait to be asked. You jump in, assess the situation, cut through noise, align the people who need to be aligned, and drive resolution.

* Partner with infrastructure and research engineering leads to identify bottlenecks, define priorities, and ensure that infrastructure investments are directly tied to research velocity.

-------------

You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand the systems to “speak the language”, i.e., to ask the right questions and identify risks early.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity, fast-moving environments. You create structure where there is none and drive clarity without waiting for permission.
* Track record of managing complex, multi-team programs with competing priorities and hard deadlines. You know how to make tradeoffs and you communicate them clearly.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across both deeply technical ICs and senior leadership. You build trust by being reliable, direct, and well-informed.
* Comfortable operating in crisis mode. You stay calm under pressure, you know how to prioritize when everything is on fire, and you follow through on the other side.
* Excited to build from zero to one. We are a small, fast-moving team and this role will help define how Research Program management Works at Reflection.
* Motivated by enabling researchers and engineers to build the world's most capable open-weight AI systems.

**What We Offer:**

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

Job Description:

**Lead Clinical Case Manager**

**Essex Support Services**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting on the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their careers.

**Program Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Felton’s The Essex Supportive Services Program provides on-site clinical case management, wellness support, and behavioral health services. Services aim to support tenants in maintaining stable housing and improving access to resources. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. Support services include clinical case management and behavioral health counseling, referral to and coordination with primary medical care, substance abuse and psychiatric treatment referrals, benefits counseling and client advocacy, meal programs, health education, community building, tenant organizing, and all other case management functions. The Lead Clinical Case Manager will coordinate the monthly group schedule and community meetings. This supervisory position provides structure and program development. * Communicate effectively, orally and in writing, with all internal and external team members and with partnering agencies.

* Provide crisis intervention to prevent hospitalization and collaborate with clinicians or other providers as needed. Respond to emergency situations as they arise.
* Commit to ongoing training, including developing specializations in evidence-based practices.
* Deliver exceptional customer service to tenants, community partners, and team.

Healthcare is broken at the first step: patients can't find the right care, understand what it costs, or access the medications they need. Mochi Health is fixing this.

We're building an AI-driven marketplace that makes healthcare discoverable—connecting patients to the right providers, transparent pharmacy pricing, and affordable medications. Over the past few years, we've grown rapidly by combining clinical expertise with technology that actually works for real people, not just hospital systems.

Our platform does what legacy healthcare can't: it gives patients transparent pricing before they pay, personalized medication management that follows them across providers, and long-term access to their own medical records. We're proving that healthcare can be more affordable, more human, and far more intuitive than what exists today.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Health, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

**About The Role**
------------------

Mochi Health is a direct-to-patient telehealth company specializing in obesity medicine and expanding into primary care. With over 200,000 active patients, 500+ providers across 50 states, and a proprietary AI-enabled EMR, Mochi is building the infrastructure for a new model of virtual care delivery.  
  
Today we operate primarily on a cash-pay subscription model. Our Insurance & Payer Operations function is one of the company's most important strategic bets: building the clinical, operational, and technical infrastructure to accept insurance and unlock a new revenue stream, and it's the engine behind our expansion into primary care.

This is a blended role: part of your time keeps clinical operations running smoothly, and part helps stand up and scale the insurance and payer side of the business as we grow.

* Monitor claims and vendor performance against collection, denial, and claims lifecycle targets.
* Help keep the program aligned with CMS billing rules, state telehealth parity requirements, and payer documentation requirements, and maintain the related SOPs.
* Partner with Engineering and Product to translate insurance-program needs into EMR requirements, and help define reporting on key program KPIs.

**Who You Are**

* Build a rare dual skill set across clinical and payer operations, with a clear path to grow into payer contracting and revenue cycle ownership.

**About Superhuman**
--------------------

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You’ll help run Superhuman’s unified audit program: quarterly audit activities across SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and our other certifications. You’ll work with our audit firms, GRC Partners, and control owners across Superhuman, and plan new audits as we expand to new frameworks, platforms, and regions. You’ll also run gap assessments that show what each expansion will take before we commit.

You’ll build the audit operating model and runbook, and drive automation so evidence can be collected and reused across frameworks where possible, requests to control owners are streamlined, and each audit cycle takes less effort than the last. Building with AI tools is a normal part of the job, with appropriate human oversight.

This is an individual contributor role for a program manager who communicates clearly, manages competing priorities, and enjoys simplifying complex processes.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Run the audit program as one program: an integrated plan and calendar across audits and expansions, with milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions tracked, and regular status updates to GRC leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run quarterly audits from scoping through report and findings closeout, including readiness ahead of each fieldwork window (control owner prep, evidence pre-checks, walkthrough dry runs).
* Scope each audit’s boundary with Product and Engineering, and flag when a launch or new platform changes it.
* Build and maintain the audit operating model and runbook as the program grows.
* Drive automation of evidence collection, request tracking, and audit reporting. Work with GRC Engineering on new ways to generate and collect evidence, and reuse evidence and walkthroughs across frameworks where applicable.
* Partner with GRC and Procurement on third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle.
* Align audit windows across frameworks and firms to minimize duplicate evidence requests to control owners.
* Plan new audits and expansions, and run framework and scope evaluations and gap assessments with recommendations and effort estimates leadership can act on.
* Work with control owners and GRC Partners to deliver evidence and close findings, and coordinate with GRC Partners on findings requiring extended remediation.
* Manage day-to-day auditor relationships, and report audit status, findings, and program metrics to GRC leadership.

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of program management experience running multi-workstream programs with plans, milestones, dependencies, risk tracking, and leadership reporting.
* 5+ years running external security audits (SOC 2 and ISO 27001 at minimum), at a company or an audit firm, including seasons with several frameworks at once.
* Working knowledge of SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and PCI-DSS and where their requirements overlap.
* Experience leading a gap assessment for a new framework or scope change and presenting the result to leadership.
* Experience building or improving an audit process: calendars, request tracking, runbooks, roles and responsibilities.
* Technical fluency to understand how evidence is produced in cloud environments, assess the completeness and accuracy of system-generated reports, and identify opportunities for automation using AI tools.
* Ability to communicate clearly, manage competing priorities, and proactively resolve blockers during time-sensitive audit cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, establish accountability, and drive deliverables without direct reporting authority.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience managing complex external audits in an in-house GRC function, consulting environment, or audit firm.
* Familiarity with additional frameworks such as ISO 42001, PCI DSS, ISO 27701 or 27018, CSA STAR, or international schemes (for example, IRAP, ISMAP, or C5).

jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What's the opportunity?**
---------------------------

Implementation is an activity every Fin customer experiences, whether they're buying Fin for the first time, expanding Fin to a new team, or adopting new features. More and more of those deployments are delivered by our partners, including the Salesforce partner community now ramping up on Fin. A partner-led deployment is only as good as the partner delivering it.

As a Partner Services Manager focused on Enablement, you'll own how our partners get certified and stay current. Your work runs from a partner's first day with Fin, through to the moment they're ready to lead customer deployments, and then every product release after that. Your primary responsibility is making sure every partner who works with a Fin customer has the knowledge, skills and readiness to deliver real value.

Partner Services Managers have an outsized impact on the company. If you want to help make business personal for our customers and you want to work with an ever growing and changing team, you're in the right place!

**What will I be doing?**
-------------------------

* You will own partner enablement end to end: how partners get certified, and how they stay current as Fin evolves
* You will onboard new partners with structured onboarding plans that take them from signed agreement to first deployment, covering Fin's product, our deployment methodology and our delivery standards
* You will run partner certification, including bootcamps, assessments and scenario-based testing. You'll certify named consultants individually, not just partner firms
* You will run Fin Deployment Partner Bootcamps, both in person and virtually, including joint bootcamps with Salesforce for its partner community
* You will build and maintain enablement content, including curricula, online courses, playbooks, hands-on labs and demo environments, and keep it up to date as new features ship
* You will check partner readiness before partners are assigned customer work. That means running readiness assessments, organising shadow and reverse-shadow on live deployments, and confirming that a partner has certified people and capacity in place

jobs.title: Virtual Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation that delivers specialty outpatient care for people living with severe mental illness, including schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, bipolar I disorder, and treatment-resistant depression. We design and operate high-acuity, in-person clinics across the United States.

Our model integrates psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community health workers under one roof to deliver coordinated, longitudinal care for a population that has historically been fragmented across systems.

Leading health systems collaborate with Amae to bring this model to their communities, including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit Health.

**Why We Are Different**

* Integrated care, not a referral network. Psychiatrists, therapists, primary care providers, dietitians, and community health workers work side-by-side and share responsibility for the same patients.
* Practice at the top of your license. Manageable caseloads, meaningful clinical depth, and purpose-built tools designed for this population.
* Continuous learning. Through our collaboration with Mass General Brigham, clinicians receive ongoing training, supervision, and mentorship in evidence-based SMI care.
* Advancing the field. Our clinicians contribute to new outcomes frameworks and research shaping the future of severe mental illness care.
* A model built for sustainability. Team-based care, thoughtful caseloads, and strong infrastructure make this work meaningful—and sustainable over time.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics on their work measures. Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**About the Role**

The Virtual Clinical Care Coordinator is the connective tissue of Amae's virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) cohorts. This fully remote role supports members as they feel welcome, show up, and stay engaged across each cohort, and keeps logistics running smoothly so clinicians can focus on care. You also support group sessions as an assistant facilitator, helping run skills practice, wellness, and engagement components under the direction of licensed clinicians.

*Scope note: This role supports but does not replace licensed clinicians. It* ***does not*** *lead psychotherapy groups, conduct clinical assessments, or make clinical determinations.*

**What You'll Do**

**Program Operations**

* Coordinate with Amae's growth & enrollment team to ensure intakes are scheduled, attended, and members are placed into the right cohorts
* Schedule and confirm appointments; manage member phone, email, and secure-message communication.
* Maintain accurate attendance and cohort records in our EHR and update member records as directed.
* Support documentation workflows and outcomes-measure reminders
* Help coordinate cohort start dates, backfilling open seats, and discharge logistics.

**Member Engagement and Support**

* Welcome new members to their cohort, walk them through the virtual platform, and complete pre-session checks.
* Reach out to members who miss sessions, identify barriers (scheduling, technology, motivation), and flag concerns to the care team.
* Foster belonging and participation in virtual sessions, including encouraging camera-on engagement and positive peer connection.

**Group Support (under clinician direction)**

* Assist licensed group facilitators with session logistics: opening the room, managing breakout rooms, tracking attendance, and monitoring chat.
* Co-lead structured, non-therapy components such as check-ins, skills practice, wellness or social activities using approved materials.
* Observe and escalate immediately any risk or safety concern to the clinician on duty per crisis protocol.

**Care Team Collaboration**

* Participate in daily/weekly care team huddles; share observations on member engagement.
* Connect members to community resources and supports that promote wellness, in coordination with therapists and the care team.

jobs.description:
**We're not a typical clinic.**

Cerebral Health exists for patients with complex neurological injuries — post-concussion athletes who aren't recovering on the expected timeline, accident survivors dealing with persistent vestibular dysfunction, people who've been told their imaging is normal but whose lives clearly aren't. We take those cases seriously. And we get results.

We're one of the few clinics in the region offering advanced neurological rehabilitation technology that most practices simply don't have. Our patients find us after exhausting other options. What we offer them is precision diagnostics, evidence-based neurological rehabilitation care, and a team that genuinely knows what they're doing.

Our team of 20 is collaborative, fast-paced, supportive, and united around a single mission — and that mission has real stakes. Our patients are coming to us to get their lives back. That means results aren't optional here. Every person on this team holds themselves to that standard: leading with a learner's heart, bringing compassion to every interaction, going above and beyond for the people in their care, and finding strength in working together. We don't just care about our patients. We are accountable to them.

That's the environment you'd be stepping into.

This is a hands-on clinic leadership role built for someone who wants to grow. You'll own the front desk and the daily operation of the clinic. From there, you'll take on the scorecard, then the team.

You'll report directly to our Director of People & Operations and be mentored by her week to week. We operate on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System): structured meetings, clear accountability, and real ownership of your results.

Your growth path

Each stage opens once you fully own the one before it and its KPIs, not just time in the seat.

* Manage the Personal Injury workflow: liens, attorney communication, PI payments and checks, subpoenas, and case follow-up

* Build, update, and enforce SOPs across all clinic functions, and train staff to them

* Track KPIs, maintain the clinic scorecard, and bring issues and solutions to weekly L10 meetings and quarterly planning

* Maintain relationships with PI attorneys and referral partners

* Help shape a culture where people do their best work and want to stay

**You'd be a great fit if you**

* Are resourceful and quick-minded, and work smart, not just hard

**Role Overview**

Congregation Kol Emeth is a collaborative, dynamic spiritual home known for our warm sense of welcome and strong Jewish vision. We are seeking an energetic and detail-oriented **Education Operations Manager** to join our team.

Reporting directly to our Morat Derech and working under her general supervision, you will play a central role in driving the daily success, organization, and growth of our youth and educational programs. Your primary goal will be to oversee program operations, own budget tracking and organizational logistics, liaise with facilities staff, and manage our summer camp. * Capability to work independently, exercise initiative, use sound judgment, and maintain confidentiality and discretion.
* **Knowledge of Jewish traditions, holidays, and life cycles**

**Preferred:**

* Experience or interest in using AI productivity tools (such as Google Gemini) to streamline workflows and enhance productivity.

**What We Offer**

* **Collaborative Community:** Work in a supportive, mission-driven environment in Silicon Valley alongside dedicated professionals and a welcoming congregation.

jobs.title: Research Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash's current and future products.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Research Operations Manager to be the operational backbone of our research team, and a driving force behind DoorDash's commitment to customer obsession. Every great product decision starts with a real voice: a Dasher, a merchant, a customer. You'll own the systems, tools, vendors, and AI-powered processes that get those voices in front of the people building for them, faster and at greater scale. You'll also champion a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement, so the research practice keeps getting better along with our understanding of the people we serve. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of research, operations, and technology, built for someone who sees friction before it's surfaced and treats it as theirs to solve.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Vendor & Procurement Management**: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of research vendor relationships — from sourcing and evaluation through contract negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing performance review. You'll manage relationships with research tool providers, recruiting agencies, transcription and analysis services, and other third-party partners. You'll establish clear SLAs, hold vendors accountable, and continuously evaluate the market for better options.

**Budget Management:** Own the research team's budget: track spend, forecast needs, manage purchase orders, and ensure resources are allocated to the highest-impact work. You'll build visibility and reporting so research leaders can make informed investment decisions, and you'll identify opportunities to optimize spend without sacrificing research quality.

**Participant Recruiting** Lead the strategy and execution of participant recruiting across studies — managing panels, recruiting vendors, and internal databases to ensure the team has access to the right participants at the right time. You'll develop screeners, coordinate scheduling, manage incentives and compliance, and build systems that make recruiting faster and less effort-intensive for researchers.

**AI-Powered Research Tooling:** Partner with researchers, engineering, design to evaluate, build, maintain, and scale AI-based tools that accelerate the research process, from automated synthesis and analysis pipelines to intelligent tagging, search, and knowledge management. You'll bring a practical, iterative approach: shipping tools that solve real problems, gathering feedback, and improving them over time.

**Culture of Experimentation** Be a visible champion for experimentation within the research team. This means creating the conditions (psychological safety, lightweight processes, shared frameworks) that make it easy for researchers to try new methods, tools, and approaches. You'll run retrospectives, document and share learnings, and help the team build an institutional memory around what works.

**Operations & Scalability** Design and maintain the operational infrastructure that keeps the research practice running smoothly: research repositories, documentation standards, onboarding materials, team rituals, and the tooling stack. As the team and its ambitions grow, you'll proactively identify bottlenecks and build solutions before they become problems. You will also partner across brands/regions to extend research operations infrastructure globally, adapting for local legal and market requirements.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in research operations, UX operations, or a closely related role
* Experience managing contractors or full-time employees, including setting priorities, providing feedback, supporting development, and ensuring delivery
* Demonstrated experience managing research vendors and procurement processes
* Experience owning and forecasting operational or project budgets
* Experience with research repositories and recruiting platforms (UserTesting, Qualtrics, etc.)
* Familiarity with prompt engineering or working with LLMs in a research or operations context. You don't need to code, but you're excited to build tools using AI and have strong intuitions about what to build and when
* A systems thinker who can zoom out to see inefficiencies and zoom in to fix them
* Strong communicator who can influence without authority and build trust across research, product, and engineering teams
* High degree of self-direction. You spot problems before they're surfaced to you and move quickly to address them

**Why This Role**
-----------------

Research Operations is often the difference between a research team that produces insights and one that produces impact. In this role, you'll have real ownership, a team that values your craft, and the opportunity to shape how a research practice operates at scale, including on the frontier of AI-assisted research.

**Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash**
---------------------------------------

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**

At XL Construction, our **Project Managers** are trusted leaders responsible for driving successful outcomes on complex construction projects. This role blends technical project execution with people leadership, ensuring budget, schedule, quality, and safety commitments are met while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

Project Managers act as the central point of coordination across owners, design teams, field staff, and trade partners—delivering projects with operational excellence and strengthening long-term client relationships. A successful Project Manager will model strong leadership, effective communication, and consistent attention to risk, planning, and continuous improvement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead all aspects of project management including estimating, preconstruction, scheduling, procurement, submittals, change orders, RFIs, budgeting, financial reporting, cost forecasting, billing, and project close-out
* Create, assemble, and manage the project control estimate
* Ensure project permits, inspections, and tests are identified and scheduled appropriately
* Work closely with field teams to develop and maintain detailed project schedules
* Resolve jobsite issues and coordinate with Superintendents to mitigate risk and ensure schedule adherence

**Client & Team Engagement**

* Lead or support Middle and End Game business development efforts, including RFQ/RFP responses
* Lead OAC meetings, site walks, and day-to-day client communications
* Build and maintain strong relationships with owners, design teams, subcontractors, and consultants
* Guide subcontractor buyout, develop subcontract agreements, and resolve contract-related issues with minimal oversight

**Collaboration & Oversight**

* Support the document control process and ensure timely updates
* Promote the use of internal resources including VDC, Lean, Sustainability, Bradley, SPW, and XL Shop, Arrow Equipment Rental, and Elevated Construction.
* Provide mentorship and technical development opportunities to Project Engineers, Coordinators, and Accountants
* Uphold and promote XL’s safety culture, policies, and procedures across all aspects of project execution

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (preferred)
* 6+ years of progressive experience in technical construction projects, such as:
* + Life Sciences, Bio-Labs, Data Centers, Manufacturing, cGMP, Structures/Interiors, Mid-High Rise, Shell & Core, Healthcare, OSHPD, K-12, Community College/DSA projects
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, MS Project/P6, PowerPoint, and Timberline
* Expert knowledge of Vista (Viewpoint)
* Ability to develop and maintain detailed construction schedules
* Deep understanding of all building trades and permitting processes
* Proven success in negotiated, customer-service based project delivery
* OSHA 10 Certification preferred
* Strong interpersonal communication and leadership skills
* Solid record of success in construction project execution

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:**

In accordance with California’s pay transparency requirements, the **base salary range for this position is $131,000 – $147,650 annually**, depending on experience and qualifications. Total compensation may also include performance-based bonuses.

XL Construction offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave
* Career development and professional training opportunities
* A purpose-driven, collaborative culture rooted in integrity and excellence

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. **About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead client projects from discovery through planning, on-site delivery and closeout. You will serve as the primary day-to-day client contact, manage project schedules and budgets, and coordinate the vendors and support teams responsible for delivery. The anticipated workload is approximately two project deliveries per month, with assignments and staffing based on project size, complexity and on-site requirements.

This role combines remote planning and coordination with in-person walkthroughs, site supervision and post-move support. Success means independently moving projects forward, maintaining clear communication and providing reliable coverage during critical activities while minimizing disruption to employees and business operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesDiscovery and Scoping**

* Lead discovery meetings and site walkthroughs to define scope, budget, schedule, inventory and site requirements.
* Source vendors, evaluate estimates and develop proposals and scopes of work, including assumptions and exclusions.

**Planning and Coordination**

* Maintain project schedules, move plans, inventories and labeling instructions.
* Coordinate clients, building teams and vendors across IT disconnect/reconnect, furniture, storage and workspace setup.
* Confirm site access, dock and elevator reservations, insurance and building requirements.
* Prepare employee move instructions and track decisions, action items and staffing needs.

**On-Site Delivery**

* Verify site readiness and direct movers, vendors and support staff during load-out, delivery, installation and event resets.
* Manage vendor sequencing, resolve issues and escalate changes affecting scope, cost or schedule.
* Inspect completed work and track post-move issues through resolution.

**Budget Management and Closeout**

* Track budgets, vendor costs, invoices and change orders; obtain approval before committing to additional work.
* Confirm client acceptance, reconcile final costs and prepare billing records.
* Archive project documentation and capture lessons learned.

**About You**

You are an experienced project manager who brings calm, sound judgment and clear direction to complex workplace moves. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take ownership without waiting for instructions. When plans change, you assess the options and bring a practical recommendation.

You work independently while keeping clients and colleagues informed. You are equally comfortable leading a client meeting and directing vendors on site, and you care as much about employees arriving at a functional workplace on Day 1 as you do about delivering within budget.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of project management experience in relocation, construction, furniture or facilities, including hands-on support for workplace moves.
* Experience coordinating movers, IT teams and vendors, with readiness to lead assigned projects independently.
* Ability to manage overlapping schedules, track budgets and invoices, and document scope changes.
* Strong attention to detail, clear communication and consistent follow-through.
* Comfort reading floor plans and furniture layouts.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and familiarity with project scheduling tools; willingness to use and verify AI-assisted materials.
* Availability for scheduled evening, overnight and weekend work, with reliable transportation throughout the Bay Area.
* Comfortable being on your feet for long stretches while supervising onsite projects.

**Skills**

* Clear, confident communication with executives, workplace teams, employees, vendors and building staff.
* Strong organization and attention to detail, with consistent documentation of decisions, action owners and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and a scheduling or project management platform such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or a comparable tool.
* Comfort using AI tools to draft and organize project materials, with responsibility for verifying accuracy and suitability before sharing them.

**Preferred Experience**

* Office decommissions, corporate events or workplace setup.
* Bay Area vendor relationships and familiarity with building access requirements.

Pay: From $50.00 per hour

We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator who enjoys hands-on work, changing environments and seeing a plan come together.

You will support all projects across Shift’s portfolio, attending scheduled moves and events to help supervise vendors, check placement and resolve setup issues. While Project Managers lead their assigned projects, you will provide consistent on-site support across the team.

This is an evolving role with room to grow into project management. You will learn how to plan moves, coordinate vendors and support clients while taking increasing responsibility for project workstreams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Move Preparation**

* Support site walkthroughs and prepare inventories, photographs and project checklists.
* Print and organize box labels, desk tags, signage and placement instructions.
* Hang signage and confirm rooms, desks and destination areas are clearly marked.
* Review move plans, floor plans and assignments with the Project Manager before each move.

**Site Supervision and Move Support**

* Attend scheduled moves and events across Shift’s project portfolio.
* Provide on-site direction to movers and support vendors within the approved move plan.
* Check that boxes, furniture and equipment arrive in the correct locations.
* Track progress, flag missing or misplaced items and escalate to the Project Manager.
* Support furniture load-out, staging and workplace resets for events.
* Keep checklists and issue logs current, with photographs where needed.

**Technology and Workplace Readiness**

* Coordinate with IT teams to confirm equipment placement and completion of disconnect/reconnect work.
* Use client-approved checklists to check workstation setup and basic technology readiness; refer technical issues to IT.
* Check shared spaces, supplies and signage before employees arrive.
* Support unpacking, organization and post-move requests, tracking outstanding items through resolution.

**About You**

You notice when a label is wrong, a box is missing or a workstation is not ready. You follow instructions carefully, ask questions when something is unclear and look for the next task without waiting to be prompted.

You enjoy being on your feet and working at different sites rather than spending every day at the same desk. You are dependable, comfortable speaking with vendors and interested in learning how to manage projects.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Experience in workplace services, events, hospitality, facilities, logistics or another role requiring organization and customer service.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow floor plans, labeling systems and checklists.
* Clear communication with movers, building staff, client employees and project teams.
* Basic proficiency in Google Workspace and comfort learning project tracking tools.
* Availability to attend scheduled moves and events, including evening, overnight and weekend assignments.
* Reliable transportation to client sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Ability to move throughout project sites during extended shifts and perform setup tasks such as posting signage and placing labels, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Prior move experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates who bring dependable follow-through and a willingness to learn.

**Growth Opportunities**

This role can be a long-term fit for someone who enjoys project coordination, with flexibility for greater responsibility for those interested in advancing.

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Commercial Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee commercial construction projects, including tenant improvements, building renovations, life sciences, biotech facilities, and ground-up developments.

This position will be responsible for managing all aspects of construction projects from preconstruction through final completion, including project budgets, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, procurement, and client relationships.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in commercial tenant improvements, renovations, and technically complex construction projects, with experience managing multiple trades, fast-track schedules, and demanding client expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage commercial construction projects from preconstruction through final completion and closeout.
* Oversee project budgets, schedules, contracts, procurement, and overall financial performance.
* Coordinate estimating, subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, and subcontractor buyout.
* Prepare and administer owner contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, and change orders.
* Develop and maintain construction schedules, project milestones, procurement timelines, and deliverables.
* Monitor project costs, financial forecasts, owner billing, subcontractor invoices, and overall profitability.
* Work closely with Superintendents and Project Engineers to coordinate field operations and construction activities.
* Manage RFIs, submittals, change orders, meeting minutes, and project documentation.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Oversee commercial tenant improvements, laboratory build-outs, building renovations, and specialized construction projects.
* Coordinate construction activities involving architectural finishes, structural systems, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) trades.
* Review construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents to identify constructability concerns and project risks.
* Manage projects involving occupied buildings, phased construction, and accelerated schedules.
* Lead owner meetings, subcontractor coordination meetings, and project progress reviews.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, budget concerns, subcontractor issues, and construction-related challenges.
* Ensure projects meet applicable building codes, safety regulations, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
* Manage project closeout activities, including punch lists, inspections, commissioning coordination, warranties, and final documentation.
* Maintain strong client relationships and support future business development opportunities.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to Project Engineers and Assistant Project Managers.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of commercial construction project management experience.
* Strong experience managing commercial tenant improvements, renovations, or ground-up construction projects.
* Background in commercial office, life sciences, biotech, laboratory, or similar construction environments.
* Proven ability to manage construction projects from preconstruction through final closeout.
* Experience overseeing project budgets, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, and procurement.
* Strong understanding of commercial construction methods, materials, and building systems.
* Experience managing project financials, including cost forecasting, change orders, billing, and profitability.
* Knowledge of commercial construction trades, including mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Strong understanding of construction scheduling, subcontractor coordination, and project documentation.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organization, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction project management software.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience managing life sciences laboratories, biotech facilities, Class A office tenant improvements, or commercial building renovations.
* Background in occupied-building renovations, phased construction, and fast-track project delivery.
* Experience managing technically complex projects involving specialized MEP systems.
* Familiarity with laboratory infrastructure, HVAC systems, process utilities, and specialty equipment coordination.
* Experience with design-build, negotiated contracts, and preconstruction services.
* Experience managing self-performed construction scopes, including carpentry, framing, and drywall.
* Proficiency with Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or similar construction management software.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Established relationships with subcontractors, architects, engineers, and commercial construction clients.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

**Additional Details**

jobs.title: W80-5 Deputy Program Manager - Active Security Clearance Required
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a Deputy Program Manager supporting the W80-5 Modernization Program. In this role, you will support the Program Manager in leading complex programmatic activities across the W80-5 program, fostering collaboration among diverse stakeholders, and driving successful execution of critical milestones. As a key leader within the Program Management Office, you will lead Earned Value Management (EVM) for LLNL W80-5 activities and ensure alignment with other sites’ program planning while helping to shape program strategies, ensure operational efficiency, and support the successful execution of a high-impact national security program. This position is in the Defense Technologies Engineering Division (DTED), supporting the Strategic Deterrence (SD) Program

*Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*

**In this role, you will**

* Support the Program Manager and lead the team in executing the W80-5 program across its current and future phases, with emphasis on testing, certification, and production.
* Oversee programmatic execution, including project management leadership for the overall program, forward financial planning through the Future Years Nuclear Security Program, and execution-year financial guidance and management.
* Provide program oversight of the monthly reporting process to NNSA: lead program management of execution, review variance analyses, support reviews, and recommend follow-on corrective actions related to the integrated program schedule.
* Monitor and proactively correct programmatic performance required to meet milestones and deliverables, including accountability for costs, schedules, risks, and execution strategies.
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful execution of program objectives, interfacing regularly with leadership from LLNL, NNSA, Navy, and sites across the Nuclear Security Enterprise.
* Deliver high-level briefings and updates to senior management, influencing program direction and decision-making.
* Identify and implement options to improve efficiency, executability, and program performance.
* Support the Program Manager by covering activities during scheduling conflicts and providing strategic guidance on program priorities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* This position requires an active Department of Energy Q-level clearance or an active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
* Extensive knowledge of, and experience in, execution of nuclear weapon design, life extension, modernization, systems engineering, requirements management, weapon assessment activities, and product realization processes between design and production agencies.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in Task Flow.
* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or similar methods to streamline workflows, cut cycle times and improve how well vulnerability remediation programs scale.
* Familiarity with data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical and cooling controls, and how cybersecurity risk turns into operational and uptime risk.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
* Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
* Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
* Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

jobs.description:
**BAKER FLOORING AND SURFACES**

**Estimator / Project Coordinator**

Job Description

**Department**

Estimating & Project Administration

**Reports to**

[President / Operations Manager]

**Location**

Burlingame, CA (hybrid or in-office)

**Employment type**

Full-time

**FLSA / CA status**

[Non-exempt (hourly) / Exempt]

**Pay range**

$98,000 – $108,000 per year, plus performance bonus

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Estimator / Project Coordinator prices commercial flooring and surface services work, helps win it, and then carries each awarded project from contract through closeout. This role owns the bid and the project paperwork, working closely with Operations, which manages crews and field performance, and with Accounting, which handles invoicing and collections.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Estimating and Bid Management**

* Review incoming bid invitations, accept bids, and assign them to the appropriate estimator or division.

* Prepare estimates using takeoffs, vendor quotes, and the company labor rate sheet; keep the rate sheet current.

* Request and follow up on pricing from suppliers and vendors by phone and email.

* Incorporate drive time and overtime into labor pricing.

* Prepare RFIs, manage bid deadlines, and submit complete proposals on time.

* Enter each bid in Salesforce with the client project manager’s contact information and the latest proposal.

**Contract Award Review**

* Verify that the company’s legal name, scopes of work, and dollar values on each contract match the awarded bid.

* Confirm inclusions and exclusions are clearly stated and priced, including power/generators, floor protection, floor preparation, demolition, and adhesive removal.

* Compare scheduled days and work dates against the time required to perform the work.

* Track pre-lien notices.

**Project Coordination**

* Schedule job starts and project timelines with clients and Operations.

* Review contracts in detail, route them through DocuSign as needed, and negotiate or correct changes with clients.

* Obtain contact information for each client’s project manager and superintendent.

* Obtain insurance requirements from the general contractor or contract and coordinate certificates of insurance with the company’s insurance broker.

* Prepare, submit, and track submittals and samples through approval.

* Order materials for awarded projects.

* Attend Project Labor Agreement (PLA) meetings.

* Upload budgets, contracts, and project documents to Procore.

* Collect work tags from Operations, prepare change order requests (CORs), and track them through approval.

* Maintain budgeted production rates, using closeout feedback from Operations to refine future estimates.

* Complete project closeout documentation.

**Billing Coordination**

* Notify Accounting when billing milestones are reached, including submittals sent, materials ordered, mockups completed, stages of work completed, and final completion.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 3 to 5 years of estimating experience in commercial flooring, finishes, or a related trade.

* Working knowledge of takeoffs, labor productivity, and material costs.

* Ability to read and interpret contracts, scopes of work, insurance requirements, and prevailing-wage or PLA provisions.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Procore, DocuSign, Microsoft Excel, and email.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

* Clear written and verbal communication with general contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Simpro or QuickBooks.

* Procore certification or formal estimating training.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is primarily office-based, with occasional job walks and PLA meetings at active construction sites, which may require walking on uneven surfaces and wearing personal protective equipment. Bid deadlines may require extended hours during busy periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* Base pay: $98,000 – $108,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance bonus: 5% to 10% of base pay, tied to bid success at target margin, on-time submissions, and contract and insurance turnaround.

* Medical insurance, with the company covering the majority of the employee-only premium.

* 15 days of paid time off plus paid company holidays.

* 401(k) with a 3% to 4% company match.

* Reimbursement of necessary business expenses, including mileage and phone.

* $1,000 to $1,500 annual professional development allowance.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

It does not constitute an employment contract; employment is at-will.*

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.
