**Shift:**

The regular hours for this position are Thursday, Friday, Saturday and every other Wednesday from 6:00am to 6:15pm.

**Job Description:**

The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. This role requires strong technical inspection skills, proficiency with microscopes and measurement tools, and the ability to collaborate with engineering and operations teams. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Inspection & Quality Control**

* Perform detailed defect inspections of advanced probing technology products using the **Olympus MX‑50 microscope** and other precision inspection tools.
* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data & Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up-to-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.
* Follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and documentation standards to maintain product traceability and compliance.

**Teamwork & Operational Support**

* Work within a shift-based team environment to support daily quality, engineering, and production activities.
* Contribute both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor to help meet daily inspection and production quotas.
* Follow a **compressed work schedule (3x4)** as assigned.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements:**

* Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components.
* Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures.
* May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment.
* Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs.

**Skills:**

Clean Room Manufacturing, Communication, Computer Literacy, Data Entry, Hand Dexterity, Microscope, Problem Solving, Working Independently

Less than 1 year of related experience. No formal occupational training is typically required | Required

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. jobs.title: Case Manager II
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**About us:**

As a Federally Qualified Health Center in Northern California with over 50 years of dedicated service to the community, LifeLong serves over 66,000 patients in the East Bay Area's socio-economically underserved regions. We provide medical, dental, behavioral health, and school-based services at more than 15 primary care sites across Oakland, Berkeley, and West Contra Costa County. From opening a residential respite program for homeless persons discharged from hospital to offering free testing to the community, we are innovative and responsive to our times' social and medical needs. We provide an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and with which our patients can identify. To this end, we seek candidates who reflect the diversity of the East Bay communities we serve.

**Benefits:**

We offer excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, dependent and domestic partner coverage, 403(b) retirement savings plan, and paid time off.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers — helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and ensuring they renew and grow.

The "technical" in the title is real. Our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders. They talk in SQL, think in data models, and evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. You need to be credible in those conversations while also being the person who can walk into a QBR with a VP of Data and connect platform metrics to business outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end-to-end — from onboarding through renewal. You're accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion within your book of business.
* Run strategic QBRs. Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards. You'll analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
* Get technical. Understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices. You won't build data models day-to-day, but you need to read them, reason about them, and guide customers toward better architecture.
* Be the voice of the customer internally. Translate customer feedback into actionable product insights. Work closely with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues and influence the roadmap.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities. Cube's platform is evolving fast — Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks and dashboards. You'll help customers understand what's new, why it matters for their use case, and how to adopt it.
* Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities. You'll own the commercial relationship alongside our sales team. This means understanding contract timelines, building the business case for renewal, and spotting natural expansion paths — more users, embedded analytics, additional environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Must-haves:

* 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and you can read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong
* Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account
* Track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment
* Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable — business narrative, not just metrics
* Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting
* Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours

Nice-to-haves:

* Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI)
* Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI — you've been on the practitioner side
* Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures
* Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical
* Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows)
* Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and generous stock options in a growing company
* Unlimited PTO — we actually use it
* Remote-first culture with coworking space stipend if you prefer not working from home
* Team offsites several times a year (locations rotate between the US and Europe)
* Professional development budget — training courses, books, conferences
* The chance to work on a product that sits at the center of the modern data stack and the AI-native future

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call — 30 min with the recruiting team
* Hiring manager conversation — 45 min to discuss your experience, approach, and what you're looking for
* Take-home exercise — prepare and present a mock QBR using a provided data pack (~3–4 hours of prep + 30 min live presentation)
* Cross-functional interviews — conversations with team mem

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Zocdoc is the country's leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Providers participate in Zocdoc's Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Opportunity:**

* Experience making engineering trade-offs between accuracy, speed, and cost in machine learning systems.

* Ability to bring clarity and decisions to a cross-functional organization.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

Most people think of YouTube as a video platform. But every day, people create far more images and text on YouTube than videos: comments, community posts, live chat messages, video thumbnails, channel profile pictures, banners, names, and descriptions. These features are everywhere across the product, they are growing quickly, and new ones launch all the time. Keeping them safe sustainably is one of the largest problems in Trust and Safety.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand how our policies, our detection systems, and our human enforcement fit together today, articulate a compelling picture of where image and text safety needs to be, and make the case for what has to change—in policy, in systems, or in process—to get there.
* Define how we measure this for every feature and every policy, and you own the goals.
* Turn today's one-off, feature-by-feature safety work into a shared system that any team at YouTube can plug into.
* Support fewer and better detection models instead of many overlapping ones.
* Make deliberate trade-offs about where to spend and where to simplify.

jobs.title: Clinical Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit—collaborate with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Opportunity:**

As a key member of the interdisciplinary clinic team, the Clinical Care Coordinator (CCC) plays an essential role in supporting members' daily experiences and sense of belonging at Amae Health. You'll help create a warm, engaging environment by facilitating group activities, wellness programming that encourage connection and growth. Working closely with our clinicians and staff, you'll share insights and contribute to a collaborative approach to member care. In addition to member engagement, you'll support clinic operations by managing communications, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with daily workflows. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented role, ideal for someone passionate about mental health, eager to learn, and excited to make a meaningful impact in their community.

**What You Will Work On:**

* **Member Engagement & Support -** Facilitate groups, arts and crafts, and recreational activities to enhance the member experience at Amae Health. Encourage positive social interactions and engagement in daily programming.
* **Clinic & Operational Support**- Welcome members to the clinic, manage communications via phone and email, and assist with scheduling and member record updates to support smooth daily operations.
* **Team Collaboration -** Collaborate with the interdisciplinary care team—including psychiatrists, therapists, dietitians, and primary care providers—to share observations and support coordinated member care. Participate in team meetings and contribute to discussions about member engagement.
* **Member Advocacy & Resource Connection** - Identify members' ongoing needs and help connect them with community resources and supports that promote wellness.
* **Growth & Development -** Contribute to projects that support clinic growth and ongoing member success. Participate in training and supervision to build skills in mental health support, community resources, and member engagement.

**About You:**

You're a people-person who enjoys creating meaningful connections and helping others feel supported. Organized and proactive, you bring positive energy to member activities and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You enjoy being part of a multidisciplinary team and contributing ideas that help members and teammates succeed. Curious and eager to learn, you welcome feedback and are motivated to grow your skills in mental health support and community resources. Most of all, you lead with empathy and keep members at the heart of everything you do. If you're excited to help shape a new clinic and make a lasting impact in your community, we'd love to hear from you!

**What You'll have:**

* Enrolled or recently graduated in a degree program related to mental health, such as pre-med, psychology, social work, or nursing
* Interest in mental health and desire to work with members with Severe Mental Illness
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment
* Detail-oriented and organized
* Comfortable working either one-on-one or in group settings, must possess excellent interpersonal skills and be able to adapt to changing situations
* Willingness to collaborate with others
* Well-organized and some experience planning and designing events and activities
* Basic computer skills are required
* The candidate should possess a holistic perspective of "health." Clinical Care Coordinators will demonstrate the ability to work effectively in a wide range of settings with people from diverse backgrounds, including members and co-workers

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.

jobs.title: Review Project Manager
jobs.description:

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

**What’s unique about this role?**

Review Project Managers are attorneys with extensive document review project management experience who serve as a central point of contact with counsel, client and internal Lighthouse stakeholders on projects requiring managed review. Review Project Managers advise on review workflow strategy and execution – focusing on the optimization of workflows and incorporation of appropriate technology to improve the speed and accuracy of any eyes-on review. The Review Project Manager provides oversight and management of work conducted by review team leads and reviewers to ensure quality and timeliness of all deliverables.

This is a dynamic consultative role focused on incorporating a tech-forward approach to drive down review volumes and increase the efficiency and accuracy of review team work product to help our clients drastically reduce spend on linear document review. The position centers on ensuring a high level of execution by contractor review teams, with a proactive consultative approach to develop and improve project workflows.

**What will this person do?**

* Implement and execute review plans that meet both Lighthouse standards and project specific requirements.
* Recommend and drive best practices in review.
* Communicate directly with counsel, client, internal stakeholders, and staffing partner on substance and progress of review, including daily project status reporting.
* Assist in development of matter-specific review project plans that address review workflow strategy and optimal application of technology.
* Establish review quality control measures and manage document review teams to ensure adherence to Lighthouse playbook, execution of throughput goals, and quality deliverables.
* Collaborate across Lighthouse teams including AI experts and data project managers.
* Implement technology efficiency drivers for redaction application and privilege logging.
* Provide client- and case-specific subject matter expertise.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:**

* Three+ years of experience as a document review manager with review provider or law firm
* Attorney, active and in good standing in any US jurisdiction

* Self-motivated, with strong sense of ownership and commitment to client satisfaction
* Knowledge of litigation discovery process and objectives
* Strong written and oral communication skills suited to a client-facing role, careful attention to detail, and general technical aptitude.

* Experience establishing matter-tailored quality control measures and managing reviews across a variety of discovery matters.

* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. Come as you are!

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Technatomy, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer’s success. We provide solutions to agencies and entities including the Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, Defense Logistics Agency, National Institutes of Health, and more. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!**

Technatomy is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager to coordinate delivery and release readiness for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) pharmacy traceability project. You turn milestones into executable plans, track dependencies across technical teams, and organize evidence for releases and deployment waves. Working with the Program Manager and workstream leads, you keep commitments achievable and progress visible.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Maintain the integrated project schedule, milestone dependencies, delivery commitments, and action tracking across workstreams.
* Lead development, integration, testing, security, training, and deployment activities across Technatomy and subcontractor teams. Establish accountable owners, track commitments, and drive corrective action when delivery falls behind.
* Organize release readiness and go/no-go reviews covering test results, security actions, required approvals, support documentation, cutover steps, and rollback readiness; record decisions and follow-up actions.
* Track site readiness and deployment wave dependencies, including access, configuration, devices, training, and local coordination.
* Manage delivery risks and issues, identify schedule impacts, and escalate decisions requiring program or customer direction.
* Maintain clear status reports, decision records, meeting actions, and deliverable acceptance tracking.
* Coordinate transition to service operations, confirm agreed handoff and stabilization exit criteria, and assign owners for open delivery items and known issues.
* Develop recovery plans for delayed access, interfaces, or site readiness, and re-sequence dependent activities with workstream leads while maintaining milestone visibility.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:**

* At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in IT project management or enterprise application delivery.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise application implementations involving SAP and/or Dynamics 365, integrated platforms, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders, with accountability for schedule, resources, and delivery outcomes.
* Ability to build and maintain integrated schedules, identify critical dependencies, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Experience coordinating software releases, readiness reviews, or deployment activities.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and the relationship between sprint work, testing, milestones, and release controls.
* Strong facilitation, status reporting, issue management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to assess critical-path impacts, reconcile conflicting workstream plans, and maintain a reliable forecast of release and deployment readiness.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS DESIRED:**

* Experience leading SAP implementations integrated with Azure services and Dynamics 365 SCM.
* Prior experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other Federal agency applications or projects.
* Experience coordinating enterprise application rollouts across multiple sites.
* PMP certification or comparable project management training.

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE:**

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

**WORK LOCATION:**

* Remote

**As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments.****We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.**

**This position requires U.S. citizenship.**

**Technatomy Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of Technatomy Corporation to afford equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.**

jobs.description:

=========================================

The Cybersecurity Project Manager is responsible for the delivery of strategic cybersecurity initiatives that strengthen the organization's security posture, reduce risk, improve compliance, and enable business objectives. Each project manager role will be anchored to projects within a key cybersecurity domain or, in some cases, to initiatives requiring partnership across multiple cybersecurity domains, such as Identity Security, Threat Management, Security Operations, Product Security, Governance, Risk & Compliance, Network Security, Cloud Security, and Emerging Technologies.

* Experience developing executive-level communications, status reporting, and decision-support materials.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment in matrixed organizations.
* Experience managing project financials, budgets, forecasts, vendor engagements, or investment-funded initiatives.

* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed environment with changing priorities.
* Fluency in ServiceNow Project Portfolio Management (PPM) for project financial management, forecasting, resource allocation, and time tracking.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI-ACP, or equivalent.
* Experience working within Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery environments.
* Experience with enterprise delivery and planning tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Jira Align, or similar platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Clinical Trials
jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we're advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Senior Project Manager accountable for managing multiple Cogstate projects overseeing the delivery of Cogstate Services. The Senior Project Manager will have experience with the pharmaceutical development process, a special aptitude and interest in scientific and technical information, an ability to motivate and mentor project and portfolio teams, and be a highly driven individual who demonstrates initiative and delivers against tight timelines in an agile environment. The Senior Project Manager will have demonstrated experience managing a full workload of clinical projects and/or internal development projects, and a growing awareness of information technology concepts and terminology and experience with direct and indirect people management. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will have confidence and composure in handling stressful situations, problem solving and communicating calmly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders, particularly in areas of disagreement.

This role will require extensive communication and interactions across multiple time zones with staff, Sponsors and clinical sites in countries all over the world.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage projects and execute tasks in line with company SOPs and agreed regulatory standards, including the following tasks:
* Manage client relationships as main POC for individual studies and some sponsor portfolios.
  + Independently lead Cogstate's complex global clinical trials projects – including implementation of projects with new service offerings in scope, where feedback is necessary to the development and commercialization teams to improve process.
* Manage Clinical Trials projects in Start-Up, Conduct or Close-Out phases (multiple projects at one time).
  + Proactively manage risks with confidence, demonstrating strong leadership in guiding team members through challenges and making decisive, well-informed decisions.
* Attending Investigator Meetings (as needed) and ensuring Cogstate is well represented.
* Work in an Agile environment with a given Portfolio Team.
  + Oversight of resourcing and financials across a Portfolio of Projects- ensure team members follow pre-determined hours allocated in budget to target gross profit consistently
* Generate invoices for assigned projects in alignment with expected timelines and project progress. Maintain a strong understanding of the broader impact of invoicing on company financials.

*Remote*

**About Diana Health**

Diana Health is a network of modern women's health practices working in partnership with hospitals to reimagine the maternity and women's healthcare experience. We are restructuring the traditional approach to care to create an experience that is good for patients and good for providers. We do that by combining a tech-enabled, wellness-focused care program that women love with a clinical system that helps us drive continuous quality improvement and ensure work-life balance for our care team. * Coordinate scheduling and logistics for provider and staff trainings, learning management system rollouts, and simulation drills with hospital partners

* Being scrappy and resourceful

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as our next Customer Success Manager on Twilio’s Twilio team.

**About the job**

At Twilio, we believe companies should be able to send their data wherever they want, whenever they want, with no fuss. We make this easy with a single platform that collects, stores, filters, transforms, and sends data to hundreds of business tools with the flip of a switch. More recently, we also developed the ability to let customers enrich their data in real time using computations they specify. Our goal is to make it easy to understand, extract value, and protect the integrity of data. We are creating a world where engineers spend their time working on their core product, letting us take care of the complexities of processing their customer data reliably at scale. We’re in the running to take over the entire customer data ecosystem, and we need the best people to take the market.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
Solovis is a leading portfolio management and analytics platform helping institutional investors navigate today's complex global markets with clarity and confidence. Backed by Insight Partners, we're building the next chapter of growth by investing in people and product to raise the bar on quality and client outcomes. Our team is driven by culture and disciplined execution, humility, and curiosity - where AI is at the core of how we operate, innovate, and serve clients. At Solovis, you'll join a tech-forward, growth-minded team that believes in learning fast, thinking big, and delivering meaningful impact for asset owners worldwide. Our companies are not the largest or flashiest, but they are among the best-run software businesses creating value for customers and shareholders at an accelerated pace. To date, our team has built six platform companies, each culminating in multiple liquidity transactions with multi-billion-dollar valuations.

**About this role**
-------------------

The Technical Account Manager is the primary post-implementation technical partner for assigned clients, providing full-lifecycle support from onboarding transition through steady-state operations and strategic engagement. Operating across Analyst Services, Professional Services, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and Product, this position is the client's internal advocate and primary technical point of contact — driving comprehension (clients get real value from their data), trust (data is complete, correct, and on time), and enablement (deeper platform adoption).

### **Key responsibilities**

* Data confidence & governance: Own data completeness across NAV, allocations, and fund entries/exits; track SLAs, manage client expectations, and serve as primary escalation point for data quality issues.
* Reporting & platform enablement: Support quarterly/monthly/daily reporting cycles, board/IC material prep, and performance packaging (IRR, MOIC, DPI); advise on complex OCIO and family-office structures.
* Voice of client: Channel structured feedback on data gaps, pain points, and feature requests to Data and Product.

* Lifecycle engagement: Own the Implementation-to-steady-state handoff and ongoing technical relationship; support renewals, monitor sentiment, and surface upsell opportunities to Sales.

### **Key qualities**

* Proficiency in utilizing data and analytics to make informed decisions and drive business strategies
* Detail-oriented and organized, this individual prioritizes effectively, excels at time management, and anticipates well in decision making
* Plays chess, not firefighting — spots problems before they exist, anticipates second- and third-order downstream impacts, and selects the intervention that compounds best.\nDistinction: Decisive under uncertainty is acting under incomplete information; Proactive Problem Solving is the upstream act of seeing the board clearly.
* Ability to swiftly adapt to changes and maintain high performance under shifting conditions and challenges
* Involves a meticulous approach to work, prioritizing accuracy and thoroughness to ensure high-quality outcomes

### **Skills**

* AI proficiency
* Manages customer relationships to enhance satisfaction and loyalty.
* Conducts thorough risk assessments to safeguard organizational interests.
* Utilizes negotiation skills to secure favorable outcomes while maintaining key relationships.
* Facilitates collaboration across various functions to achieve shared objectives.
* Focuses on maximizing customer value through superior products and services.

### **Requirements**

* Understanding of alternative investment data (PE, real assets, hedge funds): NAV reporting, capital calls, distributions, and performance metrics (IRR, MOIC, DPI).
* Experience with portfolio reporting platforms, data reconciliation, and institutional investor workflows.
* xperience with endowments, foundations, OCIOs, RIAs, SFOs, MFOs, pensions, or sovereign wealth funds; OCIO and single/multi-family office reporting structures; multi-asset class performance analysis; custodial feeds and index data integration; and SLA/escalation workflows.
* Prior experience at a fintech/SaaS platform serving institutional investors, or in fund administration, custody, or investment operations at an asset owner or allocator.
* 3+ years in a client-facing technical or investment operations role.

jobs.title: RevOps Manager
jobs.description:
**Summary** We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.

Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.

Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.

**What You'll Own**

HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored

The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses

Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal

AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.

The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.

**You're a Fit If**

You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust.

You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created.

You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ

Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex

You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling

You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing

**You're Not a Fit If**

Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix

You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue

You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation

Required Skills & Experience

* **3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems:** Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved.
* **CRM Architecture:** Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses.
* **Data Ownership:** You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number.
* **AI-Native Execution:** You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work.
* **Full-Funnel Accountability:** You measure your work through the full chain from signup trial qualified account paid renewal expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping.
* **Cross-Team Range:** Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow.

**Technical Proficiency**

HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API.

SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data.

Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, fai

------------------------

At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure - roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.

For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.

That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.

This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $78M+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

-------------------

* Technical troubleshooting instincts. You're comfortable reading error messages and sync logs, working through CSV imports and exports, and learning how a system's data model fits together. You can work out what's going on without a script.
* You're organized and keep a clean queue. No cases slip through the cracks, you set expectations with customers, and you over-communicate, especially on cases that sit with Engineering or a partner.
* You're self-starting and don't need to be told what to do next. If you see something that needs to be done, you thrive on the ownership to just do it. Ambiguity doesn't deflate you. Not everything has a process yet, and you're excited to help build it.
* Clear, warm writing. You can explain a sync failure to a stressed-out controller at month-end so it makes sense, and make them feel heard.

* Comfort using AI tools and workflows beyond the surface level. You're interested in building more, even if you haven't had the chance to flex that muscle in previous roles, you will here!
* An empathetic, service-minded approach, with genuine curiosity about the construction industry and our customers' day-to-day operations.

jobs.title: Dairy Solutions Specialist - Idaho
jobs.description:
### **Dairy Solutions Specialist**

**Remote, Idaho, United States | Full-Time | Exempt**

At Datamars, we help livestock producers make better decisions through industry-leading animal identification, activity monitoring, weighing, sorting, and data management solutions. We're looking for a results-driven Dairy Solutions Specialist to help accelerate growth within the U.S. dairy industry by partnering with producers to improve herd performance, labor efficiency, and profitability through technology-based solutions.

### **Why Join Datamars?**

* Opportunity to work with leading dairy producers across North America
* Industry-leading product portfolio and technology solutions
* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career growth opportunities within a global agricultural technology company

### **What You'll Do**

As a Dairy Solutions Specialist, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and expanding customer relationships throughout the dairy industry. You will work directly with dairy owners, herd managers, veterinarians, nutritionists, consultants, and channel partners to identify opportunities and deliver customized solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and close new business opportunities within dairy operations, calf ranches, and integrated livestock enterprises.
* Execute territory growth strategies and achieve revenue objectives.
* Conduct on-farm assessments and consult with producers on operational improvements.
* Present solutions focused on animal identification, traceability, animal health, reproductive performance, labor efficiency, and data-driven management.
* Build relationships with key industry influencers, including veterinarians, consultants, nutritionists, distributors, and equipment dealers.
* Deliver ROI analyses and business cases that demonstrate customer value.
* Collaborate closely with Strategic Account Managers, Technical Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product Management teams.

### **What We're Looking For**

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Animal Science, Dairy Science, Agribusiness, Agricultural Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 3-7+ years of experience in dairy, livestock, animal health, agricultural technology, or related sales environments.
* Strong understanding of dairy production systems and economics.
* Proven success in business development, territory growth, and consultative selling.
* Ability to manage complex sales opportunities and multiple stakeholders.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Dairy Science, Animal Science, Process Management, or related disciplines.
* Experience selling dairy technology, livestock equipment, animal health products, or herd management solutions.
* Established relationships within the dairy industry.
* Experience developing and presenting financial ROI analyses and value-based business cases.

### **Travel**

This is a field-based, remote position with approximately **50-75% travel** throughout the assigned territory, including customer visits, trade shows, industry events, and channel partner activities.

### **Compensation**

**Expected Salary Range: $90,000 - $190,000**

Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant industry experience, technical expertise, territory responsibility, demonstrated sales performance, existing customer relationships, geographic location, and overall qualifications. Because we are open to candidates with a broad range of dairy industry backgrounds, compensation may vary significantly within the posted range.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

ROLE SUMMARY  
We’re looking for a passionate Senior Sales Enablement Specialist to join our global enablement function. As part of a small, high-performing global team, you’ll design and develop high-impact training programs for our internal sales teams and expanding partner community across the global region. You will focus on delivering high-impact training programs for our internal sales team and expanding partner community. Working alongside the Sales Enablement Lead, you’ll help scale partner enablement into a strategic, repeatable capability that positions 8x8 as an aspirational channel partner. This role demands someone who loves facilitation, understands how adults learn, and isn’t afraid to leverage AI tools to build engaging training at pace, using them as a genuine accelerator, not an afterthought. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES  
Design and deliver engaging training programs for internal sales teams across multiple go-to-market segments, covering sales methodology, product knowledge, and deal acceleration frameworks. • Support product updates and launches by preparing and enabling the sales force and partner community to understand and sell 8x8s solutions • Partner with the partner enablement team to design and deliver certification and continuous professional development programs, helping scale partner training from ad hoc events into a regular monthly and quarterly cadence. • Co-facilitate global training programs, primarily virtual, when relevant to your region and business needs. Deliver in-person enablement sessions at the London office — typically on Wednesdays. • Leverage AI tools to build training content, go-to-market resources, and partner acceleration materials, actively leading the way in how AI is integrated into enablement practice. • Work collaboratively with subject matter experts, product managers, marketing, sales leaders, and channel partners to translate their knowledge into engaging, adult-focused learning experiences. • • Apply instructional design principles to accelerate content development, design, and deployment. Contribute to the ongoing evolution of our partner enablement strategy, helping shape what scaled partner training looks like at 8x8. •

REQUIREMENTS  
Experience in sales, sales/partner enablement, or learning and development with a track record of delivering engaging programs. • • Strong facilitation and presentation skills with genuine enthusiasm for delivering engaging training experiences. • Sound understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design fundamentals. • Proven comfort with AI tools and a desire to leverage them genuinely for content design, development, and delivery. • Collaborative mindset, able to work effectively across product teams, sales leadership, and channel partners. • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-moving environment. • Willingness to travel for partner events and training delivery as needed

jobs.title: Environmental Program Leader – Hazardous Waste and Dangerous Goods Compliance
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Environmental Program Leader – Hazardous Waste and Dangerous Goods Compliance will provide enterprise leadership, technical expertise, and continuous improvement across hazardous waste management and dangerous goods/hazmat transportation. In this highly visible role, the successful candidate will shape strategy, influence enterprise standards, and partner across sites and functions to strengthen compliance, standardize processes, improve environmental performance, and enable safe, reliable operations across the business.  
  
This role is ideal for a senior environmental leader who brings deep technical expertise, sound business judgment, and the ability to drive impact across a complex, matrixed organization – translating complex regulatory requirements into clear, practical, and scalable processes that support both compliance excellence and operational execution.  
  
Success in this role requires a demonstrated ability to work across functional teams to achieve environmental and compliance objectives; strong problem-solving, project management, planning, organizational, time management, and analytical skills; and strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical environmental risks and requirements for non-technical audiences and influence positive behavioral change.  
  
This position will require up to 30% travel.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead enterprise direction for hazardous waste and dangerous goods compliance, including development and execution of short- and long-term goals and objectives for the EHS function.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise standard work for waste characterization, container management, labeling, storage, inspection, manifesting, and vendor qualification.
* Provide technical environmental support, practical guidance, and compliance solutions to GE Aerospace sites on hazardous waste and dangerous goods requirements.
* Monitor environmental programs for compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, and recommend business-level environmental policies, programs, and improvement initiatives.
* Represent GE Aerospace with governmental environmental agencies and trade/professional associations to support regulatory interpretation and compliance alignment.
* Track environmental performance metrics and drive actions that improve compliance and operating performance.
* Prepare comments on proposed environmental regulations and assess potential business impacts.
* Support sites with waste determinations, supporting documentation, analytical methods, and compliance execution.
* Participate in internal and external compliance audits and support audit readiness, inspection response, CAPA development, and closure verification for recurring or material findings.
* Provide governance for dangerous goods/hazmat transportation, including classification, packaging, marking, labeling, shipping papers, modal requirements, training controls, and shipment readiness reviews.
* Review trends from incidents, near misses, shipment errors, permit events, and vendor performance to identify risks and prioritize preventive actions.
* Lead practical training and coaching for site EHS operations, with a focus on common failure modes and effective controls.

* Partner with site EHS, legal, operations, quality, and logistics teams to interpret requirements and implement practical controls aligned to site processes.
* Estimated travel required is about 30%

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in environmental compliance, hazardous waste, dangerous goods, or related EHS disciplines.
* Knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to environmental operations in the geographic regions where GE Aerospace operates.
* Experience working with complex dangerous goods and hazardous waste regulations.

**Desired Characteristics and Experience:**

* 15+ years of industry experience
* Bachelor's degree in environmental or engineering, an advanced technical degree, and/or Professional Engineer (PE) license
* Experience with Hazardous Secondary Materials

* Enterprise mindset with the ability to connect regulatory requirements to practical business execution
* Ability to simplify complex technical topics into clear expectations and actions
* Passion for building capability, strengthening standard work, and driving sustainable results.

* Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn
* Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively
* Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed
* Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative
* Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker

The base pay range for this position is $157,000 - $210,000. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. Tenants are formerly unhoused adults with co-occurring mental health, substance abuse, medical problems, and limited experience living independently. - Strategy & SME: Serve as the subject-matter expert for global digital accessibility across Twitch - advising product and partner teams, and leading process and tooling integration (including AI where appropriate).

* Education & Enablement: Develop an educational program and deploy guidelines and resources for key collaborators.

* Amazon Employee Discount

------------------------

* You have 6+ years experience building similar Accessibility programs, QA and other scalable Accessibility Practices.
* Expertise in accessibility best practices, guidelines, and regulations—specifically WCAG 2.2+ AA and the CVAA; ability to advise the executive team on risk assessment.
* Experience working on consumer product accessibility both on video and communications products and across a variety of devices, such as desktop, smartphone, gaming console, and OTT services.
* Experience with Figma, Jira and similar relevant product development tools.
* Awareness of assistive technologies available to people with disabilities.
* You have experience creating and leading an accessibility program from ground up including creating, documenting, proactive management and driving deliverables.
* Experience working with and consulting product, design, engineering, and legal teams to deliver accessibility audits, code reviews and other advisory services.

* Understanding of and familiarity with AI tooling and test automations for Accessibility
* Familiarity with Twitch as a user, streamer, or both!

*Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.*

**About Superhuman**
--------------------

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You’ll help run Superhuman’s unified audit program: quarterly audit activities across SOC 2, the ISO 27000 family, ISO 42001, and our other certifications. You’ll work with our audit firms, GRC Partners, and control owners across Superhuman, and plan new audits as we expand to new frameworks, platforms, and regions. You’ll also run gap assessments that show what each expansion will take before we commit.

You’ll build the audit operating model and runbook, and drive automation so evidence can be collected and reused across frameworks where possible, requests to control owners are streamlined, and each audit cycle takes less effort than the last. Building with AI tools is a normal part of the job, with appropriate human oversight.

This is an individual contributor role for a program manager who communicates clearly, manages competing priorities, and enjoys simplifying complex processes.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Run the audit program as one program: an integrated plan and calendar across audits and expansions, with milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions tracked, and regular status updates to GRC leadership and stakeholders.
* Plan and run quarterly audits from scoping through report and findings closeout, including readiness ahead of each fieldwork window (control owner prep, evidence pre-checks, walkthrough dry runs).
* Scope each audit’s boundary with Product and Engineering, and flag when a launch or new platform changes it.
* Build and maintain the audit operating model and runbook as the program grows.
* Drive automation of evidence collection, request tracking, and audit reporting. Work with GRC Engineering on new ways to generate and collect evidence, and reuse evidence and walkthroughs across frameworks where applicable.
* Partner with GRC and Procurement on third-party risk management across the vendor lifecycle.
* Align audit windows across frameworks and firms to minimize duplicate evidence requests to control owners.

new_jobs.title: Partner Enablement Specialist 3
new_jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What's the opportunity?**
---------------------------

Implementation is an activity every Fin customer experiences, whether they're buying Fin for the first time, expanding Fin to a new team, or adopting new features. More and more of those deployments are delivered by our partners, including the Salesforce partner community now ramping up on Fin. A partner-led deployment is only as good as the partner delivering it.

As a Partner Services Manager focused on Enablement, you'll own how our partners get certified and stay current. Your work runs from a partner's first day with Fin, through to the moment they're ready to lead customer deployments, and then every product release after that. Your primary responsibility is making sure every partner who works with a Fin customer has the knowledge, skills and readiness to deliver real value.

Partner Services Managers have an outsized impact on the company. If you want to help make business personal for our customers and you want to work with an ever growing and changing team, you're in the right place!

**What will I be doing?**
-------------------------

* You will own partner enablement end to end: how partners get certified, and how they stay current as Fin evolves
* You will onboard new partners with structured onboarding plans that take them from signed agreement to first deployment, covering Fin's product, our deployment methodology and our delivery standards
* You will run partner certification, including bootcamps, assessments and scenario-based testing. You'll certify named consultants individually, not just partner firms
* You will run Fin Deployment Partner Bootcamps, both in person and virtually, including joint bootcamps with Salesforce for its partner community
* You will build and maintain enablement content, including curricula, online courses, playbooks, hands-on labs and demo environments, and keep it up to date as new features ship
* You will check partner readiness before partners are assigned customer work. That means running readiness assessments, organising shadow and reverse-shadow on live deployments, and confirming that a partner has certified people and capacity in place
* You will track each partner's progress from enabled (delivering under Fin's oversight) to certified (delivering independently), and keep partner and consultant certification records accurate
* You will keep partners current through recertification, release briefings and regular partner office hours
* You will use delivery data, such as Partner CSAT, Fin outcomes, escalations and QA findings, to spot skill gaps and turn them into targeted enablement
* You will own enablement KPIs, including time to certification, certification pass rate, time to first deployment and post-certification delivery quality
* You will work closely with the rest of the Deployment Services team, especially fellow Partner Services Managers and AI Deployment Consultants, to turn lessons from the field into better enablement
* You'll collaborate with our Product, R&D and Education teams to get early access to new features and enable partners on them ahead of launch
* You will cover enablement progress, certification status and skill gaps in each partner's Quarterly Business Review

**What skills do I need?**
--------------------------

* 4+ years of work experience, with 2+ years in implementation, partner enablement or technical training roles
* Enablement Design: experience building training or certification programmes, ideally for partners, consultants or other technical audiences
* Facilitation: confident leading workshops and multi-day bootcamps for technical audiences, both in person and virtually
* Content Creation: the ability to turn complex product and deployment practices into clear courses, guides and hands-on exercises
* Assessment: the judgement to tell whether someone can actually do the work, not just pass a quiz, and the confidence to give direct feedback
* Technical Fluency: comfortable with core SaaS and AI concepts (APIs, integrations, LLM basics, automation logic), enough to speak credibly with technical partner teams
* Programme Management: organised and detail-oriented, able to run several partner cohorts and certification tracks at once
* Positivity and Engagement: a genuine interest in the work you do and a positive attitude!
* Curiosity: a passion for learning, for technology and for solving problems
* Adaptability: change is constant, and the Deployment Services Team values experimentation to find the best processes and solutions
* Demonstrate the Fin Values: Customer Obsessed, Success First, Incredibly High Standards, Open Mindedness, Resilience, Impatience, Positive and Optimistic

**Bonus skills & attributes**
-----------------------------

* Experience running a partner enablement or certification p

Programs include the Diabetes Empowerment Education Program (D.E.E.P.) and Chronic Disease Self-Management Program (CDSMP), with educational workshops addressing diabetes, chronic pain management, HIV, and other chronic health conditions.
