new_jobs.title: Assistant Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**We're not a typical clinic.**

Cerebral Health exists for patients with complex neurological injuries — post-concussion athletes who aren't recovering on the expected timeline, accident survivors dealing with persistent vestibular dysfunction, people who've been told their imaging is normal but whose lives clearly aren't. We take those cases seriously. And we get results.

We're one of the few clinics in the region offering advanced neurological rehabilitation technology that most practices simply don't have. Our patients find us after exhausting other options. What we offer them is precision diagnostics, evidence-based neurological rehabilitation care, and a team that genuinely knows what they're doing.

Our team of 20 is collaborative, fast-paced, supportive, and united around a single mission — and that mission has real stakes. Our patients are coming to us to get their lives back. That means results aren't optional here. Every person on this team holds themselves to that standard: leading with a learner's heart, bringing compassion to every interaction, going above and beyond for the people in their care, and finding strength in working together. We don't just care about our patients. We are accountable to them.

That's the environment you'd be stepping into.

**The role**

This is a hands-on clinic leadership role built for someone who wants to grow. You'll own the front desk and the daily operation of the clinic. From there, you'll take on the scorecard, then the team.

You'll report directly to our Director of People & Operations and be mentored by her week to week. We operate on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System): structured meetings, clear accountability, and real ownership of your results.

This is not a passive coordinator role. If you like being in the work, being the person who makes the work better, and want a seat that grows as fast as you do, this is it.

Your growth path

Each stage opens once you fully own the one before it and its KPIs, not just time in the seat.

What you'll be doing

**Front Operations**

* Lead the front desk and HBOT/PEMF teams day to day, including remote team members, and be the person they turn to

* Guide patients through the full care journey, from consultation scheduling through discharge

* Manage the Personal Injury workflow: liens, attorney communication, PI payments and checks, subpoenas, and case follow-up

* Process payments accurately across standard fees, CareCredit, PI checks, and refunds; generate superbills

* Keep patient records accurate and HIPAA-compliant; audit trackers and follow-up logs so no patient or lead falls through the cracks

* Resolve patient complaints and keep the patient experience at the standard our patients deserve

* Step in on calls, check-in, and HBOT/PEMF coverage when the clinic needs it

**Clinic operations**

* Run patient flow, scheduling, room readiness, and daily clinic logistics

* Manage vendors, supplies, supplement inventory, and facility needs

* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, OSHA, and safety standards

* Build, update, and enforce SOPs across all clinic functions, and train staff to them

* Own clinic systems including Jane, Google Workspace, and Gusto

* Track KPIs, maintain the clinic scorecard, and bring issues and solutions to weekly L10 meetings and quarterly planning

* Maintain relationships with PI attorneys and referral partners

* Coordinate monthly in-clinic patient activities

* Run hiring end to end, from job posts and screening to structured onboarding

* Process payroll and keep employee records accurate

* Lead weekly 1:1s and quarterly conversations with staff, and hold the team accountable with clarity and care

* Support performance reviews, compensation cycles, and HR compliance under California employment law

* Help shape a culture where people do their best work and want to stay

**You'd be a great fit if you**

* Have 2+ years in a healthcare or medical office setting, including at least 1 year leading, supervising, or training a team

* Are proficient with EHR or practice management systems and learn new platforms quickly

* Are organized, data-driven, and accountable to outcomes, not just effort

* Hold people accountable with warmth and clarity, and stay steady when the clinic gets busy

* Notice when a process is broken and fix it — then write it down so it stays fixed

* Are resourceful and quick-minded, and work smart, not just hard

* Lift the people around you; you win with your team, not at its expense

* Want to grow with one company for the long term, and you're ready to be mentored into a bigger seat

**What you'll get**

* Health and dental insurance

* 401(k) with company matching

* 10 days PTO

* Team bonding events

* A defined growth path into clinic leadership

* Direct weekly mentorship from our Director of People & Operations

* A team of 20 that is collaborative, fast-paced, supportive, and united around a common mission

* A high-accountability culture where our standard is directly tied to the results our patients get

If you're ready to run a clinic now and lead more of it next year, we'd love to hear from you. Send your resume and a brief note on why Cerebral Health and why now, plus one example of a process you fixed and what changed because of it.

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

* **Location:** San Francisco Bay Area client sites
* **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based
* **Capacity:** Approximately two project deliveries per month, with overlapping discovery, planning and closeout activities
* **Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates
* **Reports to:** Founder

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead client projects from discovery through planning, on-site delivery and closeout. You will serve as the primary day-to-day client contact, manage project schedules and budgets, and coordinate the vendors and support teams responsible for delivery. The anticipated workload is approximately two project deliveries per month, with assignments and staffing based on project size, complexity and on-site requirements.

This role combines remote planning and coordination with in-person walkthroughs, site supervision and post-move support. Success means independently moving projects forward, maintaining clear communication and providing reliable coverage during critical activities while minimizing disruption to employees and business operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesDiscovery and Scoping**

* Lead discovery meetings and site walkthroughs to define scope, budget, schedule, inventory and site requirements.
* Source vendors, evaluate estimates and develop proposals and scopes of work, including assumptions and exclusions.

**Planning and Coordination**

* Maintain project schedules, move plans, inventories and labeling instructions.
* Coordinate clients, building teams and vendors across IT disconnect/reconnect, furniture, storage and workspace setup.
* Confirm site access, dock and elevator reservations, insurance and building requirements.
* Prepare employee move instructions and track decisions, action items and staffing needs.

**On-Site Delivery**

* Verify site readiness and direct movers, vendors and support staff during load-out, delivery, installation and event resets.
* Manage vendor sequencing, resolve issues and escalate changes affecting scope, cost or schedule.
* Inspect completed work and track post-move issues through resolution.

**Budget Management and Closeout**

* Track budgets, vendor costs, invoices and change orders; obtain approval before committing to additional work.
* Confirm client acceptance, reconcile final costs and prepare billing records.
* Archive project documentation and capture lessons learned.

**About You**

You are an experienced project manager who brings calm, sound judgment and clear direction to complex workplace moves. You anticipate what needs to happen next and take ownership without waiting for instructions. When plans change, you assess the options and bring a practical recommendation.

You work independently while keeping clients and colleagues informed. You are equally comfortable leading a client meeting and directing vendors on site, and you care as much about employees arriving at a functional workplace on Day 1 as you do about delivering within budget.

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of project management experience in relocation, construction, furniture or facilities, including hands-on support for workplace moves.
* Experience coordinating movers, IT teams and vendors, with readiness to lead assigned projects independently.
* Ability to manage overlapping schedules, track budgets and invoices, and document scope changes.
* Strong attention to detail, clear communication and consistent follow-through.
* Comfort reading floor plans and furniture layouts.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and familiarity with project scheduling tools; willingness to use and verify AI-assisted materials.
* Availability for scheduled evening, overnight and weekend work, with reliable transportation throughout the Bay Area.
* Comfortable being on your feet for long stretches while supervising onsite projects.

**Skills**

* Clear, confident communication with executives, workplace teams, employees, vendors and building staff.
* Strong organization and attention to detail, with consistent documentation of decisions, action owners and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and a scheduling or project management platform such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or a comparable tool.
* Comfort using AI tools to draft and organize project materials, with responsibility for verifying accuracy and suitability before sharing them.

**Preferred Experience**

* Office decommissions, corporate events or workplace setup.
* Bay Area vendor relationships and familiarity with building access requirements.

Pay: From $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94114

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.

* Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Program Manager for Operational Technology (OT) Cybersecurity, you will support vulnerability management programs across the operational technology that supports critical infrastructure. These environments have tight downtime limits, safety concerns and complex vendor dependencies, so standard IT remediation practices often don't apply. You will manage vulnerability projects including end-to-end remediation, metrics development, and exceptions reporting. You will also drive the initial triage of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), judging exploitability in an OT context, checking applicability against the asset inventory, and coordinate with the OT Security Review Working Group to deliberate on a severity as needed. You will also build the program structure that makes this repeatable at scale, including tracking in Task Flow, SOPs and swimlanes. The role calls for strong ICS technical knowledge, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn technical risk into prioritized plans that protect both security and uptime.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

--------------------

* Read and interpret CVEs and ICS advisories from sources such as CISA ICS-CERT, vendor PSIRTs and Mandiant threat intelligence. Turn the technical findings into clear, actionable guidance for operational teams.
* Judge real-world exploitability in an OT context by looking at network exposure, the access an attacker would need, and device mode or state. Check advisories against the OT asset inventory to find affected devices, models and firmware versions, so remediation targets the right assets.
* Plan, track and report on cross-functional remediation programs in a project management tool such as Task Flow.
* Keep milestones, dependencies, blockers and SLO performance visible. Write and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Run triage decisions on critical vulnerabilities and send qualified findings to the right engineering, operations or vendor teams.

new_jobs.description:
**Forming Our Future together**

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

**Shift:**

The regular hours for this position are Thursday, Friday, Saturday and every other Wednesday from 6:00am to 6:15pm.

**Job Description:**

The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. This role requires strong technical inspection skills, proficiency with microscopes and measurement tools, and the ability to collaborate with engineering and operations teams. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Inspection & Quality Control**

* Perform detailed defect inspections of advanced probing technology products using the **Olympus MX‑50 microscope** and other precision inspection tools.
* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data & Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up-to-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.
* Follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and documentation standards to maintain product traceability and compliance.

**Teamwork & Operational Support**

* Work within a shift-based team environment to support daily quality, engineering, and production activities.
* Contribute both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor to help meet daily inspection and production quotas.
* Follow a **compressed work schedule (3x4)** as assigned.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements:**

* Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components.
* Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures.
* May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment.
* Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs.

**Skills:**

Clean Room Manufacturing, Communication, Computer Literacy, Data Entry, Hand Dexterity, Microscope, Problem Solving, Working Independently

**Education & Experience:**

Less than 1 year of related experience. No formal occupational training is typically required | Required

**Pay Range:**

$19.30 - $25.36

This role in Livermore, California pays between $19.30 and $25.36 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.

Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description:

**This is a full-time, hybrid position. The candidate must be located in the San Mateo, California area due to regular local travel for in-person patient appointments.**

**Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, mileage and travel reimbursement, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands-on workers’ compensation case management training.

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Field Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. * Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as attend injured worker’s appointments when appropriate, prepare status updates for submittal to customers, and other duties as assigned.

* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.

**Location:** Oakland, CA

**Account Manager Notes:**  
Senior Program Manager – IT Technology Vendor Management  
Location: [Oakland, California - Hybrid/2-3 days at the Headquarters office]  
Job Type: Full-Time, Core business hours 8AM to 5PM.
  
Department: Office of the CIO / IT Third Party Strategy and Operations / Contracts and Vendor Management Office  
Reports To: Senior Manager, IT Contracts and Vendor Management Office

**Job Description:**  
  
**Position Summary**  
The Technology Vendor Manager serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor in managing the organization’s technology vendor ecosystem. This role bridges business strategy, IT leadership, and vendor relationships to ensure technology investments deliver maximum value, are cost-optimized, and align with long-term capital and operating plans.
  
  
The Technology Vendor Manager has a genuine passion for operational excellence and vendor management, possesses robust communication and interpersonal skills, demonstrates high analytical capabilities, is vendor-focused, team-oriented and highly capable of working independently and cross functionally to meet operational and business objectives.
  
  
The Technology Vendor Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Architecture, and Sourcing, to define vendor-specific requirements, and oversee performance through KPIs and SLAs. Success in this role requires agility in communication, with the ability to engage confidently with executives while working closely with technical teams and individual contributors.  
  
The Technology Vendor Manager plays a critical role in aligning vendor strategy with the organization’s technology and business objectives. This position works across operations, enterprise architecture, sourcing, and IT leadership to manage vendor and support program reporting to executives to enable strategic decision-making. The role ensures technology purchases are optimized, integrated, and aligned with the company’s multi-year capital and expense investment plans.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Through strong partnerships with internal stakeholders – including sourcing, IT, architecture, finance, legal and business teams – ensures vendor relationships contribute measurable results to PG&E performance objectives
* Partner with Operations, Architecture, IT Leadership, and other stakeholders to align and document vendor capabilities
* Develop and deliver innovative commercial models that contributes to the CIO financial savings target
* Establish and enhance Tier-1 and Tier-2 strategic supplier relationships, engage with suppliers and their leadership regularly
* Conduct periodic supplier reviews to discuss performance, document product roadmaps and business needs.
* Seek out disruptive technologies, establish relationships, discover opportunities to POC and partner with IT stakeholders to rationalize the existing technology footprint.
* Leverage internal and external data to provide insights and recommendations that enhance supplier performance and operational efficiency
* Translate technology requirements into vendor-specific solutions that integrate with multi-year capital and expense investment plans.
* Manage the full lifecycle of vendor relationships, including onboarding, governance, performance reviews, and contract compliance.
* As a senior individual contributor within the Vendor Management function, this role ensures suppliers deliver consistently against contractual commitment, service level agreements, and compliance requirements while driving operational excellence and innovation
* Proactively identify and resolve operational challenges, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop quantitative analysis and reporting on supplier performance by tracking and reporting performance using KPIs and SLAs, driving accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with the Sourcing department to develop negotiation strategies, optimize costs, and ensure favorable contract terms.
* Provide strategic insight and recommendations to executives while also engaging at a detailed level with technical and operational contributors.
* Identify risks, opportunities, and innovations within the vendor portfolio to strengthen business outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders—including Operations, Architecture, and IT Leadership—to develop vendor-related technology strategies and requirements.
* Manage vendor relationships across the lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology roadmap
* Engage as required in market analysis, trending, value assessment, and business requirements for alternative approach strategies
* Conduct Total Cost of Ownership analysis for vendor relationships, evaluating both direct and indirect costs to inform decision-making and optimize cost efficiency.
* Financial: understanding of vendor-driven spend forecasts segmented into Capital and Expense. Ability to present forecasts to Finance and IT Leadership.
* Ensure technology investments are integrated with capital and operating expense plans while supporting enterprise strategy and priorities.
* Represent vendor strategy at both executive and operational levels, adapting communication style to engage with senior leaders and individual contributors.
* Proactively identify risks, opportunities, and innovation potential within the vendor ecosystem.

**Required Qualifications**

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

**The Role**
------------

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers — helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and ensuring they renew and grow.

The "technical" in the title is real. Our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders. They talk in SQL, think in data models, and evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. You need to be credible in those conversations while also being the person who can walk into a QBR with a VP of Data and connect platform metrics to business outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end-to-end — from onboarding through renewal. You're accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion within your book of business.
* Run strategic QBRs. Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards. You'll analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
* Get technical. Understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices. You won't build data models day-to-day, but you need to read them, reason about them, and guide customers toward better architecture.
* Be the voice of the customer internally. Translate customer feedback into actionable product insights. Work closely with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues and influence the roadmap.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities. Cube's platform is evolving fast — Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks and dashboards. You'll help customers understand what's new, why it matters for their use case, and how to adopt it.
* Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities. You'll own the commercial relationship alongside our sales team. This means understanding contract timelines, building the business case for renewal, and spotting natural expansion paths — more users, embedded analytics, additional environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Must-haves:

* 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and you can read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong
* Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account
* Track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment
* Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable — business narrative, not just metrics
* Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting
* Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours

Nice-to-haves:

* Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI)
* Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI — you've been on the practitioner side
* Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures
* Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical
* Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows)
* Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and generous stock options in a growing company
* Unlimited PTO — we actually use it
* Remote-first culture with coworking space stipend if you prefer not working from home
* Team offsites several times a year (locations rotate between the US and Europe)
* Professional development budget — training courses, books, conferences
* The chance to work on a product that sits at the center of the modern data stack and the AI-native future

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call — 30 min with the recruiting team
* Hiring manager conversation — 45 min to discuss your experience, approach, and what you're looking for
* Take-home exercise — prepare and present a mock QBR using a provided data pack (~3–4 hours of prep + 30 min live presentation)
* Cross-functional interviews — conversations with team mem

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.

Our celebration of diversity and foundation of inclusion allows us to leverage our differences and capitalize on our similarities to better serve our communities. We do it because it's right!

**Job Description:**

Responsible for carrying out case management activities for PPO members identified through data or by Health Plan and referred to HPMG. Case management is a collaborative process that assesses, plans, implements, coordinates, monitors, and evaluates options and services required to meet the client’s health and human service needs. It is characterized by advocacy, communication and resource management and promotes quality and cost-effective interventions and outcomes. Case management activities are based on nationally recognized case management standards and concepts and principles. All contacts are telephonic.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Health Plans care and disease management programs to maximize the at-risk population member’s quality and manage their costs.
* Assess members’ physical and psychosocial needs/barriers and develop a care plan.
* Support and encourage the use of participating Health Plan providers.
* Develop and implement the interventions needed to resolve barriers and coordinate care, allowing members to accomplish their goals with physician guidance and supervision.
* Document in Epic; assessments, care plans, interventions, and all other activity related to coordinating the care of case-managed members.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Maintain client privacy, safety, confidentiality, and advocacy while adhering to ethical, legal, regulatory and accreditation standards.
* Maintain department procedure/policy standards with regard to turnaround time, etc.
* Support the interdisciplinary team approach to ensure effective resource utilization, as well as quality and cost-effective outcomes.
* Coordinate internal and external resources for the individual member.
* Maintain and update a community resource database.
* Document all case management activities in the HPMG case management online system.
* Issue letters of explanation in accordance with department policy.
* Attend and participate in in-service programs and conferences that support practice of case management.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum three years clinical nursing experience in an area such as medical/surgical, critical care, home health or skilled nursing, and;
* Two years of experience in case management, behavioral health, utilization management, discharge planning, and or quality improvement in a managed care setting.
* Experience with managed care delivery including IPA networks and Medicare. PPO experience preferred.
* Optimum organizational skills with ability to meet both expected and unexpected time frames.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Ability to work independently with self-initiative and discipline.
* Knowledge of ICD-9 and or CPT coding.
* Working knowledge of personal computers.

**Required Education**

* A.S. degree

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

MaiaLearning (“Maia”) is seeking an entry- or mid-level Customer Success Specialist to lead successful platform adoption across new and existing school, district, and state customers. Primarily serving customers in Pacific, Mountain, and Central US time zones, this role will guide college and career readiness implementations from onboarding through launch and sustained use. This is not a sales position. This role centers on supporting schools and districts in successfully leveraging the Maia platform to achieve their college and career readiness goals.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You may be a great fit if you are a former school counselor, college advisor, educator, or EdTech customer success professional, who is extremely tech-savvy and enjoys training adults, managing implementation projects, building relationships, and helping schools achieve meaningful student outcomes.

* Support customers through on-time implementation, adoption, technical troubleshooting, and ongoing success
* Deliver virtual and in-person training to educators, counselors, and administrators
* Develop training resources, manage project timelines, and ensure key milestones are achieved
* Provide thorough first-line technical support and escalate requests as needed
* Collaborate across teams to meet customer needs and improve the customer experience
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and readiness scores through training and support interactions
* Perform additional duties and special projects as needed

**Work Location**

This position is remote. Preference will be given to candidates residing in Arizona due to the need for occasional on-site training and support for schools and districts in the region. Qualified candidates located elsewhere in the United States will be considered if they are able to work 8:00AM – 5:00PM Pacific Standard Time and can travel occasionally within the region. Travel is minimal and typically represents less than 5% of working time.

**Required Qualifications**

* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new software systems and technologies
* Demonstrated experience delivering engaging virtual and in-person training, preferably in K–12 education or educational technology
* Strong communication, presentation, customer service, and problem-solving skills

* Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to deliver on-site training within the US

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of college and career readiness, counseling, and postsecondary planning
* Experience in K–12 education, school counseling, college advising, educational technology, and/or school administration

**About Maia**

MaiaLearning (“Maia”) is a leading college and career readiness platform that helps K–12 students discover, plan, and prepare for successful futures. Serving schools, districts, and state education agencies across the United States and in more than 70 countries, Maia combines innovative technology with exceptional customer service to empower educators and support student success. At Maia, you’ll be part of a mission-driven, collaborative team dedicated to innovation, exceptional customer experiences, and meaningful educational impact. You’ll play a critical role in helping educators leverage technology to improve student outcomes and postsecondary planning success.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Inogen’s growing Clinical Affairs team is seeking a versatile and adaptable, hands-on Clinical Operations Manager to execute and oversee clinical studies across its respiratory medical device portfolio, including airway clearance and mask technologies. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable setting study plans, managing vendors and budgets, and directly supporting sites through monitoring, documentation review, issue resolution, and closeout.

The position requires strong individual ownership, team collaboration, practical judgment, and the ability to shift between strategic coordination and day-to-day execution in a lean, agile, fast-moving clinical organization. The individual will work independently while partnering closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Data Management, and external study partners.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Clinical Trial Management and Study Execution**

* Manage assigned studies from feasibility and start-up through enrollment, conduct, database lock, and closeout; maintain integrated study plans, milestones, deliverables, and action logs.

* Track site and sponsor TMF/eTMF completeness, document quality, and inspection readiness; remediate gaps when appropriate.

### **Other Responsibilities**

* Support identification, documentation, reconciliation, and escalation of adverse events, serious adverse events, device deficiencies, product complaints, and protocol deviations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to manage timelines, budgets, monitoring deliverables, essential documents, risk tracking, and study reporting.
* Working knowledge of ISO 14155, FDA device clinical investigation requirements, GCP, informed consent, safety escalation, and TMF/eTMF management.
* Strong writing, organization, prioritization, problem-solving, communication skills, and willingness to travel.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting both U.S. and European studies, including GDPR and post-market clinical follow-up activities.

* Experience supporting reimbursement-focused evidence generation, enrollment recovery, and lean sponsor-side operations.

**What is special about Lighthouse?**

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

**What’s unique about this role?**

Review Project Managers are attorneys with extensive document review project management experience who serve as a central point of contact with counsel, client and internal Lighthouse stakeholders on projects requiring managed review. Review Project Managers advise on review workflow strategy and execution – focusing on the optimization of workflows and incorporation of appropriate technology to improve the speed and accuracy of any eyes-on review. The Review Project Manager provides oversight and management of work conducted by review team leads and reviewers to ensure quality and timeliness of all deliverables.

This is a dynamic consultative role focused on incorporating a tech-forward approach to drive down review volumes and increase the efficiency and accuracy of review team work product to help our clients drastically reduce spend on linear document review. The position centers on ensuring a high level of execution by contractor review teams, with a proactive consultative approach to develop and improve project workflows.

**What will this person do?**

* Implement and execute review plans that meet both Lighthouse standards and project specific requirements.
* Recommend and drive best practices in review.
* Communicate directly with counsel, client, internal stakeholders, and staffing partner on substance and progress of review, including daily project status reporting.
* Assist in development of matter-specific review project plans that address review workflow strategy and optimal application of technology.
* Establish review quality control measures and manage document review teams to ensure adherence to Lighthouse playbook, execution of throughput goals, and quality deliverables.
* Collaborate across Lighthouse teams including AI experts and data project managers.
* Implement technology efficiency drivers for redaction application and privilege logging.
* Provide client- and case-specific subject matter expertise.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:**

* Knowledge of litigation discovery process and objectives

new_jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Technatomy, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer’s success. We provide solutions to agencies and entities including the Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, Defense Logistics Agency, National Institutes of Health, and more. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

**If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!**

Technatomy is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager to coordinate delivery and release readiness for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) pharmacy traceability project. You turn milestones into executable plans, track dependencies across technical teams, and organize evidence for releases and deployment waves. Working with the Program Manager and workstream leads, you keep commitments achievable and progress visible.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Maintain the integrated project schedule, milestone dependencies, delivery commitments, and action tracking across workstreams.
* Lead development, integration, testing, security, training, and deployment activities across Technatomy and subcontractor teams. Establish accountable owners, track commitments, and drive corrective action when delivery falls behind.
* Organize release readiness and go/no-go reviews covering test results, security actions, required approvals, support documentation, cutover steps, and rollback readiness; record decisions and follow-up actions.
* Track site readiness and deployment wave dependencies, including access, configuration, devices, training, and local coordination.
* Manage delivery risks and issues, identify schedule impacts, and escalate decisions requiring program or customer direction.
* Maintain clear status reports, decision records, meeting actions, and deliverable acceptance tracking.
* Coordinate transition to service operations, confirm agreed handoff and stabilization exit criteria, and assign owners for open delivery items and known issues.
* Develop recovery plans for delayed access, interfaces, or site readiness, and re-sequence dependent activities with workstream leads while maintaining milestone visibility.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:**

* At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in IT project management or enterprise application delivery.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise application implementations involving SAP and/or Dynamics 365, integrated platforms, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders, with accountability for schedule, resources, and delivery outcomes.
* Ability to build and maintain integrated schedules, identify critical dependencies, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Experience coordinating software releases, readiness reviews, or deployment activities.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and the relationship between sprint work, testing, milestones, and release controls.
* Strong facilitation, status reporting, issue management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to assess critical-path impacts, reconcile conflicting workstream plans, and maintain a reliable forecast of release and deployment readiness.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS DESIRED:**

* Experience leading SAP implementations integrated with Azure services and Dynamics 365 SCM.
* Prior experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other Federal agency applications or projects.
* Experience coordinating enterprise application rollouts across multiple sites.
* PMP certification or comparable project management training.

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**CLEARANCE:**

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

**WORK LOCATION:**

* Remote

**As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments.****We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.**

**This position requires U.S. citizenship.**

**Technatomy Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of Technatomy Corporation to afford equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.**

The Cybersecurity Project Manager is responsible for the delivery of strategic cybersecurity initiatives that strengthen the organization's security posture, reduce risk, improve compliance, and enable business objectives. new_jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we're advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Senior Project Manager accountable for managing multiple Cogstate projects overseeing the delivery of Cogstate Services. The Senior Project Manager will have experience with the pharmaceutical development process, a special aptitude and interest in scientific and technical information, an ability to motivate and mentor project and portfolio teams, and be a highly driven individual who demonstrates initiative and delivers against tight timelines in an agile environment. The Senior Project Manager will have demonstrated experience managing a full workload of clinical projects and/or internal development projects, and a growing awareness of information technology concepts and terminology and experience with direct and indirect people management. In addition, the Senior Project Manager will have confidence and composure in handling stressful situations, problem solving and communicating calmly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders, particularly in areas of disagreement.

This role will require extensive communication and interactions across multiple time zones with staff, Sponsors and clinical sites in countries all over the world.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage projects and execute tasks in line with company SOPs and agreed regulatory standards, including the following tasks:
* Manage client relationships as main POC for individual studies and some sponsor portfolios.
  + Independently lead Cogstate's complex global clinical trials projects – including implementation of projects with new service offerings in scope, where feedback is necessary to the development and commercialization teams to improve process.
* Manage Clinical Trials projects in Start-Up, Conduct or Close-Out phases (multiple projects at one time).
  + Proactively manage risks with confidence, demonstrating strong leadership in guiding team members through challenges and making decisive, well-informed decisions.
* Attending Investigator Meetings (as needed) and ensuring Cogstate is well represented.
* Work in an Agile environment with a given Portfolio Team.
  + Oversight of resourcing and financials across a Portfolio of Projects- ensure team members follow pre-determined hours allocated in budget to target gross profit consistently
* Generate invoices for assigned projects in alignment with expected timelines and project progress. Maintain a strong understanding of the broader impact of invoicing on company financials.
* Actively maintain the change order process.
* Oversee internal projects focused on developing processes for implementing new technologies, with the ability to map, visualize, and optimize workflows to support commercialization and scaling efforts
* Develop operational deployment plans for new systems, including training, and operate as the point person for support.
* Work closely with Business Development and project team managing relationship and supporting proposals for key accounts.
* Potential to line manage or indirectly manage and mentor other project management team members and clinical operations staff in the future.
* Analyze reports for project hours and budget utilization and making course corrections in conjunction with Operations Line Managers.
* Forecast invoicing based on expected timeline and progress of the study
* Ability to review Work Orders and determine deliverables and timelines for project.
* Ensure accurate reporting to internal and external stakeholders on service delivery and progress.
* People/Staff management: Demonstrate high performance in mentoring other project management team members and clinical staff.

**Requirements**

* Microsoft Office proficiency.

**What's In It For You**

* Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!

**Grant Program Manager, Tennessee**

*Remote*

**About Diana Health**

Diana Health is a network of modern women's health practices working in partnership with hospitals to reimagine the maternity and women's healthcare experience. We are restructuring the traditional approach to care to create an experience that is good for patients and good for providers. We do that by combining a tech-enabled, wellness-focused care program that women love with a clinical system that helps us drive continuous quality improvement and ensure work-life balance for our care team. We work with clients across all life stages to empower and support them to live happier, healthier, more fulfilling lives.

With strong collaborative care teams; passionate administrators and a significant investment in operational support, Diana Health employees are well-supported to bring their very best to the work they love. Come join us!

**Role Description**

You will be the day-to-day owner of a multi-year, state-administered grant that extends our care model across rural Tennessee through workforce development, patient engagement, and digital enablement. You will keep a large, cross-functional effort organized, on schedule, and audit-ready, and you will make it easy for clinical, operational, product, and finance teammates to do their best work. You will report to the VP of Finance and partner closely with Operations, Finance, Product, Analytics, and our clinical quality leaders.

#### **Grant management and compliance**

* Own the master workplan, deliverables calendar, and reporting calendar across all 3 program pillars, and keep milestones on track
* Prepare and submit progress reports, reimbursement requests, and supporting documentation in partnership with Finance and Analytics

#### **Cross-functional coordination**

* Run the grant operating rhythm: weekly working sessions, monthly leadership updates, and quarterly reviews
* Facilitate communication across clinical, recruiting, training, marketing, product, engineering, and analytics teams

#### **Clinical quality partnership**

* Work with clinical quality leaders (VP of Clinical Operations, Regional Clinical Director, Chief Medical Officer and Chief Clinical Officer) to organize priorities across quality improvement projects, TIPQC participation, and quarterly clinical governance reviews

#### **Training and onboarding coordination**

* Coordinate scheduling and logistics for provider and staff trainings, learning management system rollouts, and simulation drills with hospital partners
* Track completion data so training outputs are ready for grant reporting

#### **Measurement and reporting**

* Partner with Analytics to keep metric definitions, data collection, and quarterly reporting consistent with our logic model

#### **You Are**

* A detail-oriented organizer who stays calm while juggling many moving pieces
* A clear, warm communicator who builds trust with clinicians, operators, and funders
* Someone who follows through, documents decisions, and closes loops
* Energized by improving process and learning new tools
* Motivated by better outcomes for mothers and babies

#### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required
* 4+ years of experience in grants management, program management, or project management, ideally in healthcare
* Working knowledge of state or federal grant compliance, including cost allowability and reporting requirements
* Excellent writing skills and comfort with spreadsheets and project tools (Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence)
* Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy standards
* **Preferred:** women's health or maternal health experience, Medicaid/TennCare familiarity, PMP or CGMS certification

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, dental & vision plans, with an HSA/FSA option
* 401(k) with employer match
* Paid time off

**Diana Health Culture**

* Having a growth mindset and striving for continuous learning and improvement
* Positive, can do / how can I help attitude
* Empathy for our team and our clients
* Taking ownership and driving to results
* Being scrappy and resourceful

**About us** We are a team of trauma-informed counselors serving children, teens and adults across New York, with virtual sessions in New Jersey. We specialize in somatic therapy, Brainspotting and IFS: care that goes beyond talk therapy and that most people can't find elsewhere. Every dollar we earn also supports children who have survived human trafficking.

**The role** You are the first voice people hear when they reach out for help. Many have tried therapy before, and some are calling on a hard day. Your job is to listen, help them feel understood, explain clearly what makes our care different, and book them into a free consultation with the right therapist before the call ends.

This is a healthcare sales role with heart: consultative, relationship-based sales, not cold calling. If you've helped people say yes to something valuable that insurance doesn't fully cover, like cosmetic treatment, Invisalign, LASIK, fertility care, private school or premium memberships, you'll recognize the work.

**What you'll do**

* Answer and return every new inquiry by phone, text and web form, within 10 minutes during your shift
* Lead warm, confident conversations that end with a scheduled free consultation
* Explain our private-pay model and out-of-network reimbursement clearly, without apologizing
* Match callers to the right clinician and offer our $100 associate sessions when budget is tight
* Follow up with callers who didn't book, by call and text
* Log every inquiry and its outcome in our client system
* Review recorded calls weekly with the founder and keep improving

**You'll be great at this if you**

* Have 2+ years in consultative sales, patient coordination, admissions or high-end client service
* Can talk about price calmly and confidently
* Are warm, steady and an excellent listener, including when someone is upset

*No clinical or mental health license is required. You will never give clinical advice. Our therapists handle that.*

Pay: $20.00 - $32.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Learning and Development Specialist, Remote
new_jobs.description:
The **Specialist, L&D** supports the People Team in designing and implementing high-impact learning programs. Under the leadership of an L&D Manager, the Specialist, L&D will partner with leaders, key stakeholders, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in business units to support the design, development, implementation and management of learning programs that drive employee performance. The Specialist will leverage experience in adult learning principles to create and manage a wide range of learning interventions and support tools including elearning courses, videos, v/ILT training sessions, job aids, and intranet pages. Learning programs will focus on creating scalable and sustainable learning solutions as the company grows, and tie into critical employee processes such as performance reviews, competency frameworks, and more.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office

### **Primary Duties**

* With manager coaching and guidance, manage learning programs from design to evaluation and implementation.
* Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and team members to develop and implement learning interventions utilizing a variety of modalities, including AI-assisted content creation and design, designed to improve employee performance.
* Support the design and application of best-fit learning modalities (elearning, videos, job aids, v/ILT, intranet pages, AI-enabled tools and assistants, etc) under managerial coaching.
* Serve as facilitator - with manager coaching as needed - for ILV/vILT training sessions, workshops, and other L&D-led events.
* Stay on top of learning trends and technologies, including emerging AI capabilities, and pilot and share effective AI practices with the L&D team and the broader business.
* Flex to support other parts of the L&D organization as priorities and workload shift, including learning design and development surge support, program delivery and facilitation, and learning operations, and perform other duties as required.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience supporting the development and implementation of learning programs.
* Exposure to creating and managing learning across a variety of learning modalities (e-learning creation, video creation/editing, ILT, and informal learning).

* Establish long-term relationships with POCs and other key stakeholders to drive outcomes that contribute to mutual success

new_jobs.description:

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

**Job Summary** :

We are seeking an Account Manager with a strong hunter mentality! As an Account Manager at The Uniform Solution, part of Fullsteam you will be responsible for both driving new business through outbound prospecting and growing existing customer relationships through expansion and upsell opportunities.

**What sets this role apart:**

* Develop new business through outbound prospecting and strategic outreach
* Identify and close expansion, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities within existing accounts
Operate with an ownership mindset and a passion for achieving and exceeding sales goals  

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders with new and existing customer base through phone, video, email and face to face to understand their business goals and challenges.

* Create and execute strategic account plans to identify growth opportunities and drive expansion within assigned accounts.

* Deeply understand customers business needs and match to qualifying products and solutions.

* Identify and pursue opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products and services that align with customer needs and objectives.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.

* Ability to think strategically and identify new business opportunities with new accounts and growth opportunities within existing accounts.

* Strong understanding of sales processes and techniques for outbound prospecting as well as upselling and cross-selling.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and persuasively.

* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to address and resolve customer issues effectively.

* Ability to analyze customer data, market trends, and account metrics to inform strategy and decision-making.

* Exceptional organizational and time management skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.

* In-depth understanding of the software technology industry and market dynamics.

* Outstanding knowledge of MS Office and proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and customer success tools.

* Fast and adaptative learner, focused on improving customer and business processes.

* Advanced negotiation skills.

* Driven by achieving and exceeding targets, with a strong focus on results.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field preferred.

* 3+ years of experience in software sales, preferably within the SMB and mid-market segments.

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Solovis is a leading portfolio management and analytics platform helping institutional investors navigate today's complex global markets with clarity and confidence. Backed by Insight Partners, we're building the next chapter of growth by investing in people and product to raise the bar on quality and client outcomes. Our team is driven by culture and disciplined execution, humility, and curiosity - where AI is at the core of how we operate, innovate, and serve clients. At Solovis, you'll join a tech-forward, growth-minded team that believes in learning fast, thinking big, and delivering meaningful impact for asset owners worldwide. Our companies are not the largest or flashiest, but they are among the best-run software businesses creating value for customers and shareholders at an accelerated pace. To date, our team has built six platform companies, each culminating in multiple liquidity transactions with multi-billion-dollar valuations.

**About this role**
-------------------

The Technical Account Manager is the primary post-implementation technical partner for assigned clients, providing full-lifecycle support from onboarding transition through steady-state operations and strategic engagement. Operating across Analyst Services, Professional Services, Customer Success, Support, Sales, and Product, this position is the client's internal advocate and primary technical point of contact — driving comprehension (clients get real value from their data), trust (data is complete, correct, and on time), and enablement (deeper platform adoption).

### **Key responsibilities**

* Data confidence & governance: Own data completeness across NAV, allocations, and fund entries/exits; track SLAs, manage client expectations, and serve as primary escalation point for data quality issues.
* Reporting & platform enablement: Support quarterly/monthly/daily reporting cycles, board/IC material prep, and performance packaging (IRR, MOIC, DPI); advise on complex OCIO and family-office structures.
* Voice of client: Channel structured feedback on data gaps, pain points, and feature requests to Data and Product.
* Special projects & restructuring: First to identify portfolio reclassification needs; lead scoping and coordinate with Professional Services and Sales into formal SOW.
* Lifecycle engagement: Own the Implementation-to-steady-state handoff and ongoing technical relationship; support renewals, monitor sentiment, and surface upsell opportunities to Sales.
